title: The wardrobe
summary: In a forgotten room stands a wardrobe carved with frozen forests. The child may flee back to bed (kislev.102) or look closer (kislev.103).

title: Back to bed
summary: Without taking your eyes off the wardrobe, you back out of the room. Only when it is out of sight do you turn and run to your quarters, slam the door and leap...

title: Inside
summary: The wardrobe closes behind the child.

title: The frozen land
summary: The back of the wardrobe opens on a snowbound forest. The left path leads nowhere (kislev.105); the right to a ruined village (kislev.106).

title: The cold
summary: You follow the path for what seems like hours. Your fingers and toes go numb, and you begin to think longingly of the warm bed waiting in your room.

title: Something in the ruins
summary: A beast prowls the dead village. Running is safer (15% caught); hiding risks more (35% caught) but leads to the gem (kislev.109, 110).

title: Safe
summary: Without a moment's hesitation you turn and run for the wardrobe. When you are just a few feet away you glance back, but whatever it was has not followed you.

title: Caught
summary: The beast's claws find the child, who escapes bleeding.

title: Unseen
summary: You duck into the nearest doorway and crawl under the rotten frame of a bed. You wait without a sound for what feels like hours, until the presence fades away,...

title: The gem
summary: A gem of blue ice glows in the ruined hearth. Touching it awakens the child's gift: an Ice Witch for a girl, a warlock for a boy (and the Sisterhood hunts such men). A shard may come away in the child's hand (rare artifact kislev_wardrobe_shard).

title: Power
summary: As you lay your hand on the stone it flashes with a blinding blue light, and a cold power floods through you, sharp and wonderful. You cry out before you can...

title: Was it a dream?
summary: The child wakes on the floor in the morning sun; the wardrobe is gone.

title: One Kislev
summary: A Gospodar ruler who holds land in Kislev decides that Gospodar, Ungol and Ropsmann should become one people. The ruler takes up the new Kislevite culture and spreads it to Kislev city or one Gospodar province. Once per ruler; a player who refuses may be asked again. After that the culture spreads by kislev.151 - 153.

title: It's spreading
summary: The Kislevite culture spreads to one more of a Kislevite ruler's provinces in Kislev.

title: The new ways at court
summary: A courtier of a Kislevite ruler in the Tsardom takes up the new culture.

title: The new ways in the realm
summary: A vassal of a Kislevite ruler in the Tsardom takes up the new culture and is told so (kislev.154). Fixes the old version, which skipped the Tsar and every other independent ruler.

title: I am a Kislevite now
summary: The vassal's unlanded Kislevite courtiers follow them into the new culture.

title: Rebellious Erengrad
summary: At game start, a feudal ruler of Kislev who faces a burgher republic in Erengrad may claim the city by force (Kislevite and Norscan rulers call it tyranny) or demand a bribe (kislev.202). The AI ruler also founds the Tzar Guard five years later (kislev.205).

title: The fate of the Veche
summary: When the ruler of Kislev takes Erengrad after claiming it, they may burn the burghers' Veche and seize the city, or let the burghers keep their trade as vassals under the holder of the Erengrad duchy.

title: The ultimatum
summary: The burghers decide whether to pay the ruler of Kislev or defy them.

title: The burghers pay
summary: Erengrad pays and becomes a permanent tributary of Kislev.

title: Erengrad unmoved
summary: The burghers refuse. The ruler of Kislev gains a claim on the city.

title: The Tzar Guard
summary: The ruler of Kislev founds the palace guard (decision organize_kreml_guard, or five years after kislev.200 for the AI). A veteran captain is made its commander.

title: The guard reborn
summary: Notice for the ruler who founded the Kreml Guard (kislev.205).

title: Riot at the ice track
summary: Backers of rival sledge-racing teams riot in Kislev. Send in the Kreml Guard (kislev.211) or leave it to the city watch (kislev.212).

title: The Guard is unleashed
summary: Hundreds of rioters are hacked down as the armoured guardsmen of the Kreml march into their ranks with axe and halberd. Many try to flee, but the Guard gives...

title: The watch holds the line
summary: The watch pulls men in from the other quarters and at last breaks up the rioting crowds. Several streets are burning and looting is rife where the watch had to...

title: The guardsman and the tsarevna
summary: An unwed daughter of the ruler has fallen for one of the Kreml Guard and asks leave to marry him. Was broken: it fired for the daughter's own child and asked the child's father.

title: The Guard runs amok
summary: Drunken guardsmen wreck a quarter of the city and the mayor wants justice. Was fired by every Kislevite mayor of a player's realm on MTTH.

title: Recruits for the Circle and the Duma
summary: Every five years an AI warrior of Ursun's faith may join the Circle of the Bear, and an AI Kislevite lord may take a seat in the Boyar Duma.

calls: kislevsoc.40; kislevsoc.41; kislevsoc.42; kislevsoc.50; kislevsoc.95; kislevsoc.96; kislevsoc.97
title: Society life
summary: Every two years a member may meet one of their society's flavour events, and a Grand Ice Witch is called to the Ice Palace.

title: The Bear Hunt
summary: The hunters have found the bear. Face it by Ursun's law (mostly the kill, kislevsoc.11; sometimes a mauling, kislevsoc.12), or lower the spear when it rises before you (kislevsoc.13).

title: The bear falls
summary: The kill. Counts for rank 2, earns Ursun's Favour, and may bring the Pelt of the Great Bear or, for a Champion, a bear too stubborn to die.

title: Mauled
summary: The bear wins this time. The hunter lives, barely.

title: The bear stands
summary: The hunter lowers the spear and the bear walks away. The priests call it a sign.

title: A Circle trial
summary: A Bear Brother chooses the trial for rank 3: ride north against a Chaos champion (kislevsoc.21), ride south with the Gryphon Legion (kislevsoc.22), or hold a stanitsa against the raiders (kislevsoc.24).

title: The champion of the north
summary: A Chaos champion has ridden out of the Wastes looking for a worthy foe. Fight him. Killing him wins the trial and pushes back the dark a little.

title: South with the Legion
summary: The Bear Brother rides south with the Gryphon Legion for a season of war in the Empire. They come home in a year and a half (kislevsoc.23).

title: Home from the Legion
summary: Three times in four the ride is a triumph and wins the trial.

title: The stanitsa on the steppe
summary: Raiders out of the north are riding on a stanitsa. Hold the walls, or ride out to meet them.

title: The trial is won
summary: Counts for rank 3. One time in four a bear-claw talisman comes with it.

title: The trial is lost
summary: The Bear Brother comes home wounded and must try again in a few years.

title: Waking Day
summary: Ursun wakes in spring and the host leads the feast: dance with the bear, bless the hunt, or judge the contest of strength.

title: A brother's pyre
summary: An old Bear Brother is burned on the steppe with his axe and his horse. Speak at the pyre, or sit with the old men and drink.

title: A young rider's challenge
summary: A young rider of the rota challenges the member to a wrestling bout in front of the Circle. Accept (mostly a win), or laugh it off.

title: The priest's escort
summary: The Rota of the Dawn guards a senior priest of Dazh on the road. Wolves, bandits or worse wait in the snow.

title: The palace weeps
summary: A Grand Ice Witch is called to keep the Ice Palace whole for the crown. Do the work (it costs her standing, wins the crown's thanks), or leave it dripping. A Tzarina who is herself an Ice Witch needs no help; a ruler who moved to the Bokha Palace or let it melt does not ask (tsar.10).

title: A task for the Duma
summary: A member takes on a task to rise in the Duma. One of four comes up: broker a marriage (kislevsoc.61), fund a rebuilding (kislevsoc.62), win a trade contract (kislevsoc.63) or speak at court (kislevsoc.64).

title: The two houses
summary: Two great boyar houses want a marriage and need a go-between who both trust. A diplomacy task.

title: Rebuild the burned town
summary: A town burned by raiders needs money to rise again. A stewardship task that costs gold up front.

title: The amber contract
summary: A southern merchant house wants a contract for amber and furs. Win it for the Duma. A stewardship task.

title: Speak for the Duma
summary: The member speaks for the Duma before the Tzar(ina). A diplomacy task; the crown's mood counts.

title: The task is done
summary: Counts towards the next rank. One time in six a Praag filigree chain or a sable kaftan comes with the thanks.

title: The task fails
summary: The bride ran away with a horse trader the night before the wedding. Both houses blame you.

title: A great feast
summary: The boyars come to eat, drink and hunt. Every Kislevite vassal and every Duma member of the same realm thinks better of the host.

title: A petition from the Duma
summary: A boyar of the Duma petitions the Tzar(ina): tax relief for their lands, or the crown's favour. Grant one or refuse (kislevsoc.81 tells them).

title: The crown's answer
summary: The crown has granted your petition: your lands are relieved of the crown's taxes for five years.

title: The Duma convenes
summary: The Voice of the Duma calls the boyars together. Squeeze them for a levy (gold, and some resent it), or let them air their grievances (goodwill and prestige).

title: Old blood, new blood
summary: An old boyar sneers at the druzhina as upstarts in borrowed furs. Side with the old families, or with the crown's new men.

title: Gospodar and Ungol
summary: A Gospodar boyar and an Ungol ataman quarrel over grazing rights at the member's court. Favour one or split the difference.

title: The guild master's gift
summary: An Erengrad guild master leaves a heavy purse and asks a favour of the Duma. Take it, or send it back.

title: The omens
summary: Once a game. The High Speaker of Ursun, or the First of the Circle of the Bear, sees the signs that the Father of Bears lies wounded in the east: a bear walks into the hall and lies down, the stars burn over the High Pass. Heed them and send a company east (ursun.2), or dismiss them.

title: The company rides east
summary: Choose who leads the company: the best rider of the Circle at court (or a champion found for the task), or the speaker in person.

title: The edge of the Wastes
summary: A Chaos warband crosses the company's trail. Fight (the leader's martial), or hide in the snow (the leader's intrigue). A loss counts against the quest; two losses or a dead leader end it in the Long Sleep (ursun.8).

title: The passes of the World's Edge
summary: Greenskins hold the pass. Fight through, or take the long way round over the ice (the leader's health and learning).

title: The Ogre road
summary: An Ogre tribe of the Mountains of Mourning blocks the road east. Pay their toll in gold, or fight. Then on to the resting place (ursun.6), or the Long Sleep (ursun.8) if the company is broken.

title: The resting place
summary: In a cave under the mountains the company finds a bear the size of a hill, breathing slow, with a black wound in its side. Offer blood (the leader's), offer a life (a prisoner), or take a tooth for a relic: the Tooth of Ursun, at the risk of waking the god in rage. Success brings Ursun Wakes to every lord of Kislev's gods; the relic gamble can bring the Long Sleep (ursun.8).

title: Ursun wakes
summary: Sent to every player lord of Kislev's gods when the quest succeeds: the Father of Bears is awake, and for twenty-five years the realm has Ursun Wakes (morale, piety, levies, a little health).

title: The Long Sleep
summary: The company is lost, or the god woke in pain and turned away. For twenty-five years Ursun sleeps: bears turn on men (ursun.9) and the cults of the Dark Gods grow bold in Kislev (doom rises a little).

title: Bears turn on men
summary: During the Long Sleep a bear comes out of the forest and mauls one of the court. Kill it (a hunt) or let the priests of Ursun try to soothe it.

title: The drunk boyar
summary: At the Waking Day feast a boyar, deep in his cups, mocks the Father of Bears in front of the whole court. Punish him, forgive him, or let him wrestle a bear and see what Ursun thinks.

title: The strongest man in the oblast
summary: A young man has won every contest of strength at Waking Day and asks to serve. Take him as a champion of the court, send him to the Circle of the Bear, or send him home with a purse.

title: Hidden. A siege takes the capital of a lord of Kislev's gods, and
summary: the temple flame of Dazh goes out (ursun.31 to the lord).

title: The flame goes out
summary: The capital has fallen to the enemy and the hearth of Dazh in the temple is cold. Until it is relit, the realm has Cold Hearths (fewer children, poorer health, no birth rites, no northern blood). Send a priest of the Rota of the Dawn to carry the flame back, make the pilgrimage to the temple in Kislev, or leave it for now (a decision relights it later).

title: The flame is lit again
summary: The flame comes home from the temple in Kislev, or in a priest's iron lantern, and the hearths of the realm are warm again.

title: Hidden. A war begins: a lord of Kislev's gods on either side may
summary: swear on Tor's thunder (ursun.41).

title: Tor's Oath
summary: The warriors gather before the war and the priest of Tor asks whether the lord will swear on the thunder: no flight and no surrender. One who keeps the oath to the end of the war gains martial; one who loses the war is struck down by the thunder (rarely) or is Oathless for life.

title: Hidden. The attacker won: the defender broke Tor's oath, the
summary: attacker kept it.

title: Hidden. The defender won: the attacker broke Tor's oath, the
summary: defender kept it.

title: Hidden. A white peace: neither side won, and the oath is simply
summary: released.

title: The oath is broken
summary: The war is lost. One time in twenty the thunder comes for the oath-breaker; otherwise they are Oathless for the rest of their life.

title: The oath is kept
summary: The war is won and the oath held. Tor's priests paint the lord's shield with lightning. Martial, once a lifetime as a lasting gain; after that, prestige.

title: The barrow of the Khan-Queen
summary: A Gospodar lord reaches the barrow of Miska on the steppe. Pray at the tomb (a chance of her vision: the Heir of Miska for a woman, Miska's favour for a man), or dig for the grave goods (gold and a curse). Grave robbers may already be at work (ursun.51).

title: Grave robbers
summary: The lord's guards catch men tunnelling into the barrow. Hang them, or take a share of what they found and let them go (gold and the curse).

title: The horse bones
summary: An Ungol lord of the old gods watches the wise women read the year in horse bones. Listen, or tell them to read it again.

title: The ancestors are hungry
summary: The spirits of the lord's ancestors come to the wise women and ask for a sacrifice: a horse, a prisoner, or nothing at all.

title: The dream of the bear
summary: Once the lord has read the bones or fed the ancestors, a great bear comes to them in a dream. Keep to the old ways, or turn to Ursun and the gods of Kislev. Ungols turn easily; this is the story of it.

title: The priests and the mutant
summary: A Kislevite of the court has mutated despite the northern blood, and the priests of Ursun demand they be cast out. Cast them out of the realm, throw them in the dungeon, or protect them and anger the priests. mutant.

title: The Great Warding
summary: A Grand Ice Witch goes to the Lynsk and pours her own life into the ice. For ten years her lord's provinces in Kislev are warded (no Spring Driving burns them so easily, and they are calmer), and doom falls back. The rite costs her health for the rest of her life. Once per witch.

title: The sorcerer's trail
summary: A Chaos sorcerer is hiding in the oblast: dead cattle with their eyes burned out, a village that dreams the same dream. Follow the trail to him (frostwitch.11), or send the Chekist and the lord's men instead.

title: The duel of ice and fire
summary: The witch meets the sorcerer in a burned village. A duel of magic: her learning and rank against his. A win brings currency, prestige and a little less doom; a loss brings wounds.

title: The frozen river
summary: The witch freezes the river in the pulk's path, and her lord's armies cross where no bridge stands (better organisation for a year).

title: The warp-breach
summary: Where the daemons came through in this war the air is still torn. Seal the breach (the witch's learning; doom falls a little), or leave it to the priests. A failed sealing costs her health or her mind.

title: The watch over the Ball
summary: An Ice Witch at the court of the Tzar(ina) keeps watch over the Ice Queen's Ball. Watch the masks (a cultist caught, her lord grateful), or dance.

title: A winter on the glacier
summary: A Grand Witch takes a novice up onto the Frosthome glacier for a winter. A test of the novice's health and learning: she comes down stronger in the Sisterhood, or wounded, or not at all.

title: Two Grand Witches
summary: Two Grand Ice Witches at the same court fall out over a novice or a seat at the lord's side. Settle it with a duel of ice (learning; the loser is wounded), make peace (friends), or yield the seat.

title: The hag of the village
summary: An Ice Witch meets an Ungol hag who calls the Sisterhood children playing with snow. Scorn her, learn the older magic from her, or, when Chaos is in the land, swear a pact with her against it.

title: The Sisterhood comes for the girl
summary: An Ice Witch has come to the hag's village to take a girl with the gift to the Sisterhood. Let her go (a better life, and the Sisterhood owes you), hide her and teach her the old ways yourself, or trade the old lore for the Sisterhood's respect.

title: The hut that walks
summary: An Ungol or Ropsmann pilgrim goes deep into the woods to find the hut of the Hag-Mother, the first of the hags, which walks on its own legs. Knock and go in (frostwitch.61), call her by the old name, or turn back.

title: The Hag-Mother
summary: Inside, the Hag-Mother sets her questions. A pilgrim who answers well comes home with her distaff (a great artifact, one in the world while it lasts); most come home wiser; some never come home. A hag, and one who called her by the old name, does better.

title: Knights Errant at the gate
summary: Yearly random_events (00_on_actions). A small court with a chancellor to receive them is likelier; sick, mad or great rulers are less likely.

title: Hurt in the lists
summary: A knight is injured in a friendly tilt; the visit ends.

title: One knight shines
summary: Players only: the host may take the young knight into service.

title: A courtier takes offence
summary: A proud man of the court is mocked by the knights.

title: A girl of the court is seduced
summary: Players only. A young unwed woman of the court falls for one of the knights and is with child.

title: The knights ride on
summary: The Knights Errant are saddling their horses. They have heard tales of a beast in the forests to the east and mean to be the ones to slay it. The whole court...

title: The visit goes on (hidden)
summary: Picks the next scene. The knights stay for at most three scenes, then ride on; a recruit makes them leave sooner (was MTTH 40 days, x0.1 with a recruit).

title: The marshal has arrested a Knight Errant
summary: Yearly random_events (00_on_actions). Freeing him costs the marshal face; leaving him makes the ruler hated by the knights, who stop visiting.

title: The Herrimault
summary: An outlaw in the ruler's woods robs tax carts and gives the coin to the poor, and the peasants sing of him. Wish him well (prestige; a noble may come to complain, legend.2), swear to catch him (a chance of diligent or deceitful; a noble complains), or let it be (a chance of content). Either way the ruler's council brings it up within the year (legend.4). Once per game. Players of the Old World faiths with bandits or unrest in their lands.

title: A noble complains
summary: A noble of the court was robbed in the woods (a lady of her jewels or a lord of his purse and his dignity). Pay them off, or promise that something will be done (a chance of diligent or ambitious). Fixed: the old pair of events (one per sex) used break = yes, and the lord's version could never give ambitious after diligent.

title: A trap for the outlaw
summary: The council asks what to do about the Herrimault. Leave it (prestige, and a craven or slothful streak), hold an archery contest no outlaw could resist (legend.5), or go into the woods in disguise (legend.10). Was MTTH 12 months on a flag; now scheduled by legend.1.

title: The archery contest
summary: Every bowman of the realm comes for the silver arrow. Half the time the outlaw is taken (legend.6); half the time an old man wins and is gone before the prize is cold (legend.7).

title: The outlaw in chains
summary: The Herrimault is caught at the contest. Hang him (legend_outlaw_hang_effect) or pardon him and take his band into service as gamekeepers (legend_outlaw_pardon_effect).

title: An old man wins
summary: A bent old man splits the winning arrow and vanishes with the prize.

title: It did not work
summary: The old man was the outlaw. Give up (prestige, and the brave, honest and proud of the court think less of the ruler) or try the disguise (legend.10).

title: In disguise
summary: The ruler dresses as a pedlar and goes into the woods. The disguise may fail (legend.11), the ruler may stumble on the outlaws' camp (legend.12) or meet the giant on the bridge (legend.13). A ruler who turns back may still be found out (1 in 10).

title: Found out
summary: The outlaws see through the disguise and send the ruler home in shame, and a new robber band takes heart.

title: The outlaws' camp
summary: The ruler stumbles on the camp. Join the feast (legend.17) or slip away (outfoxed, and the robbers grow bold).

title: The giant on the bridge
summary: A huge outlaw with a quarterstaff bars the bridge. Fight him (win, legend.14; lose, legend.15; or be found out, legend.16) or turn back (craven, or deceitful for one who already is; outfoxed).

title: The giant goes into the river
summary: A feint, a sweep, a lucky crack across the knees, and the giant goes into the stream with a splash that drenches the bank. He comes up spluttering and...

title: The ruler goes into the river
summary: I last three blows. On the fourth the staff takes my feet out from under me and I go into the water head first. The giant fishes me out by the collar and claps...

title: The disguise slips
summary: The giant knocks the ruler's hood back and knows the face from the coins. The ruler is beaten and robbed (and may be wounded) and sent home.

title: Around the outlaws' fire
summary: The ruler is welcomed at the outlaws' fire. Ride with them against a tax collector (legend.18), go with them on a night's adventure (legend.19), betray them to the guard (legend.21; the dishonest of the court admire the trick), or pay for the ale and go home (outfoxed). Fixed: the last option used the text of another event.

title: Robbing the tax collector
summary: The band robs the ruler's own tax collector and hands the silver out in the villages. Have them seized (legend.21), go home and leave them be (met the outlaws; one robber band leaves), or remember the way to the camp for an ambush (legend.22).

title: A night's adventure
summary: The band frees a poacher from a cruel lord's gibbet. Seize them (legend.21), set an ambush (legend.22), enjoy it (legend.20), or go home and leave them be.

title: That was fun
summary: The ruler rides home with a grin and a story nobody will believe.

title: The outlaw before the throne
summary: The Herrimault is brought in chains. Hang him or pardon him.

title: Ambush in the greenwood
summary: The ruler's men fall on the camp. Kill them all (a chance of a wound, wroth or cruel; the band is gone) or spare the leader and take the band into service.

title: The outlaw weds
summary: The pardoned Herrimault marries his sweetheart at court.

title: A rift in the earth
summary: A chasm opens in the ruler's lands, and fiery stones fly from it. Ignore it (a chance of slothful, or content for the already slothful) or go and look (legend.101 soon). Ignored, it gets worse within a year or so. Was MTTH 10000 months on every player ruler.

title: Fire and stones
summary: The rift spits fire and burning stones. Keep ignoring it (the peasants of the capital grow upset) or look deeper (legend.102 soon); ignored, the screams start within a year or so. Was MTTH 12 months.

title: The screaming
summary: Screams and pleas rise from the rift, in voices the villagers swear they know. Keep ignoring it (the worst modifier, for four years, and the chain ends) or try to close it (legend.103).

title: How to close the rift
summary: Pray it shut (any faith but the Chaos gods), feed it cattle (50 gold; not for the greedy), fill it with stones, or give it the heir, a son of 10 to 19 years: what the realm holds most dear. Fixed: going back from a choice found the event's own flag still set and ended the chain; the old way flags were never cleared, so later rifts showed more than one ending.

title: Prayer at the rift
summary: The priests pray over the rift: 9 in 10 it closes (legend.108), else it does not (legend.109). The ruler may also think again (legend.103).

title: Cattle for the rift
summary: Herds are driven into the rift (50 gold): 9 in 10 it closes.

title: Stones for the rift
summary: The peasants roll boulders into the rift: 9 in 10 it closes.

title: What we hold most dear
summary: The heir is thrown into the rift: 9 in 10 it closes. A pacifist faith costs piety. The ruler may still change their mind.

title: The rift is closed
summary: The rift closes, and the way it was closed is remembered for five years: prayer (learning, the faithful), cattle (stewardship), stones (martial, prestige) or sacrifice (intrigue, and dread).

title: The rift is still open
summary: Nothing worked; the ruler loses face and must choose again.

title: A calling
summary: Picks one lifestyle chain that fits the character. The old MTTH modifiers are kept as weights.

title: The book without a title
summary: A hooded man presses a strange book on the character. Chase him (scholar, lifestyle.12) or read it (lifestyle.11).

title: The mystery of the book
summary: The book's secret: give up on it (scholar) or crack its code (mystic).

title: A love of books
summary: The book was nonsense, but the character learned to love books: scholar.

title: The code broken
summary: The book was a cipher, and the key leads deeper: mystic.

title: The nettlesome neighbour
summary: A neighbour's envoys keep begging for gold. Send roses (lifestyle.22) or nail their hats to their heads (lifestyle.21).

title: The neighbour is quiet
summary: The hats worked. Stop there, or try the same on criminals (lifestyle.23).

title: The neighbour is grateful
summary: The roses worked. Stop there, or take up gardening (lifestyle.25).

title: Atone for thy sins!
summary: The people pelt the ruler for the new impalements. Carry on (impaler, lifestyle.24) or grow roses instead (gardener, lifestyle.25). A Shallyan cannot carry on.

title: The skilled torturer
summary: The ruler learns the art of impalement: impaler, or a year of fun.

title: The garden
summary: The garden becomes the ruler's joy: gardener, or a year of roses.

title: The icy lady
summary: An unmarried man courts a cold lady at court. Poetry or deeds of valour, each with an even chance of success (lifestyle.31 - lifestyle.33).

title: She is unmoved
summary: Give up, or try the other way: the duel after poetry (lifestyle.34), the poems after valour (lifestyle.35).

title: She likes the poem
summary: I struggled with the poem for days, and sent it to her with a trembling heart. Her answer was warm and lovely. It seems the ice princess has thawed at last.

title: She likes the valour
summary: I never told my heart's desire that I would win her with deeds of valour, but soon I saw her at every tournament and every duel I fought. She began to smile at...

title: The great tournament
summary: He must win the greatest tournament for her (lifestyle.36).

title: The book of poems
summary: He has his best poems copied out for her (lifestyle.37).

title: The champion
summary: He won, and the lady is his lover: duelist, or prestige.

title: Published!
summary: The scribes sold copies of his poems, and the lady is his lover: poet.

title: Bored
summary: A bored man takes up hunting or falconry; either goes well or badly (lifestyle.41 - lifestyle.44).

title: A disastrous hunt
summary: Give up, or try falconry (lifestyle.46).

title: A fortunate hunt
summary: We set out early, with the sun barely over the hills. There was game everywhere. The dogs caught many hares, and I slew a great boar before it could gut my...

title: A disastrous falcon
summary: Give up, or try hunting (lifestyle.45).

title: A fortunate falcon

summary: A magic law faction demands one step its way: the anti-magic revolters want fewer rights, the pro-magic revolters more. Giving in changes the law and tells the faction (magiclaw.11 - 13); refusing means war, and a weak faction may draw rebel bands, a strong one loyalists for the ruler.

title: Power grows
summary: The mage has gathered enough experience for the next level of magic power.

title: A breakthrough
summary: While pondering the Winds, a mage has an insight and gains magic experience. Bright, studious and Tzeentch-touched minds have them far more often; the strongest mages have little left to learn.

title: Raise the dead
summary: The necromancer spends necromantic power to raise a horde: each level spent calls up a greater host, and the dead may answer in greater numbers than he asked for.

title: The dead rise
summary: The horde claws its way out of the earth and the land around it withers.

title: The dead fall apart
summary: The magic holding the horde together runs out. The necromancer may raise another.

title: Daggers in the night
summary: The mage looks into the threads of fate and unmasks one hidden plotter against him or his close kin. The plot loses much of its backing. flames_of_fate, fortune_told).

title: Your scheme is laid bare
summary: Your hidden schemes are no match for the sorcerous gaze of . knows what you have been planning, and half your backers have melted away.

title: Drink an elixir
summary: Each elixir raises one skill by a point, up to 15.

title: Eat warpstone
summary: Warpstone feeds a mage's power but brings madness, mutation and addiction; a whole cluster may kill. Necromancers instead draw on the death in it: dust gives one level of necromantic power, a shard three, a cluster all five.

title: Drink a potion
summary: You look over the potions in your possession. Each promises something different.

title: Eat a mushroom
summary: Scarlet Elf Cap leaves the eater's blood and blades venomous; Madcap fills him with power and frenzy, at the usual price.

summary: The mage gets a fee from the price and learns from the work (magicxp). AI mages say no only to a buyer they dislike.

summary: Delivered even if the mage has died meanwhile: the work was nearly done.

title: Nomad heir keeps the faith
summary: When a nomadic ruler dies, an heir of another religion group takes the ruler's faith. A government flip between chaos_horde_government and nomadic_government crashes the game, so the heir must match.

title: Samur chapter needs a witch hunter
summary: The Samur witch hunter chapter is destroyed when it passes to someone who is not a witch hunter.

title: The Everqueen dies
summary: A dying Everqueen hands Avelorn to her living heir (aiclean.4).

title: The new Everqueen
summary: The heir becomes Everqueen, drops her placeholder court title and receives every title of the late Everqueen.

title: Crown lost
summary: Every two years an Everqueen without Avelorn or a Phoenix King without Ulthuan loses the trait.

title: Dwarf newborns look young
summary: Newborn dwarfs and Chaos Dwarfs that inherited an old-age portrait set get the young one.

title: Growing old
summary: Every five years a human, Skaven or halfling of 50, or a dwarf or Chaos Dwarf of 200 (lifespan_age_50_trigger), gets the old-age trait that matches their looks; women become infertile and men less fertile, once. Old dwarfs get the grey-bearded portraits. Elves, immortals, Chaos champions and ice witches do not age this way.

title: Vassal conversion demanded
summary: Fired by the demand-conversion decisions: passes the demand to the vassal (aiclean.9).

title: Vassal conversion carried out
summary: Runs the vanilla conversion event faith.700 (WHG_faith_events) for the saved converted target.

title: Spell failed
summary: Notification that a spell fizzled: the caster loses 25 prestige. Fired by the magic decisions.

title: Woodwalking ends
summary: Removes the woodwalking trait when its timer runs out. Fired by the magic decisions.

title: Greenskin government reset
summary: A new greenskin title holder on the second greenskin government goes back to the normal one.

title: Master dies
summary: When a mage dies, their apprentices are freed.

title: Dwarf ranks at game start
summary: Gives starting dwarf men the rank that fits their age and skills: beardling under 75, then thunderer, quarreller, hammerer or warrior, and longbeard from 250. Cowards are flagged and never become warriors.

title: Special titles die with their holder
summary: The Red Dukedom, Drachenfels and the Sylvanian empire are destroyed when their holder dies.

title: The Akghan church goes on
summary: When the head of the Akghan church dies, a new human mage of his faith and culture is created to take over (aiclean.17). The Rector of Martek is replaced by university.31.

title: Titles pass to the successor
summary: The new mage receives every title of the dead holder.

title: Elven youth
summary: Elves at adolescence become elven maidens or scions, which keeps them from low-born marriages; aiclean.19 ends it about 45 years later.

title: Elven youth ends
summary: Between 45 and 65 elves lose the youth trait, gain 50 prestige and can marry.

title: Court cleansing
summary: Every ten years an AI ruler below king with five or more Skaven breeders or ten or more Khemri soldiers at court quietly loses all of them. The AI spawns too many of them.

title: Mining outpost taken
summary: After a siege of a trade post, checks a day later (aiclean.22) whether the mining outpost still stands.

title: Mining outpost gone
summary: Clears the mining outpost flag from a province that lost its trade post.

title: Crown law cooldown cleared
summary: A new holder of a crown law title clears the crown_law_change flag.

title: Dynasty bloodlines
summary: A newborn joins every always_transfer bloodline their parents own when they share the dynasty.

title: Places of power and the Mists of Albion
summary: At the start of a new game sets the active, corrupt and inactive places of power across the map and the Mists of Albion (unless the game rule turns them off). Runs once, for the host.

title: Women's titles need a woman
summary: A man holding a female-led title (Sisters of Sigmar, Frosthome Lodge and the like) abdicates to a newly created woman of his faith and culture: a priestess for theocracies, a soldier otherwise. His court follows her, and the Frosthome heir becomes an ice witch.

title: Slann are Mage-Priests
summary: Gives every Slann the Mage-Priest character title.

title: Corsair titles
summary: Atruhayid feudal rulers with a port capital get corsair titles by tier.

title: The Dragon Emperor
summary: Fired from Xen-Huong's character history: creates the Heavenly Court, grants the imperial baronies and the nickname the Heavenly Master.

title: Game start setup
summary: At the start of a new game: Skaven surface tunnels under the burrows, secret faiths for members of the Chaos and Atharti cults, and male holders of female-led titles vanish (aiclean.26 has already replaced them).

title: A lore for the untrained

title: The high temples
summary: Hidden. The holder of the Inquisitoria (b_inquisitoria_general) or the Mater Myrmidia (b_matermyrmidia), a Myrmidian theocracy that is free or serves a Myrmidian king or emperor, gets the high temple of Magritta or Remas as a duchy and becomes the direct vassal of that king or emperor. If the head of the Cult of Myrmidia holds neither temple, the head takes the temple and its see. A high temple whose holder has lost the see, the faith or the theocracy falls.

title: A bad new home

title: The cat comforts you
summary: The cat cures a stressed or depressed owner.

title: Cat and dog
summary: The owner's cat and hound fight. Give one away or let them sort it out (pet.21).

title: Did they figure it out?
summary: One pet in four runs off or is killed by the other; otherwise they become best friends.

title: The stray cat

title: A prize at sea
summary: Hidden. A pirate lord's ships take a noble passenger off a neighbour's coast: a ruler, a rich courtier, the liege's close kin or a councillor of a great house. Any wards travelling with them are taken too (pirate.11). capital. Fired by the five-year pirate_raids list (wh_on_actions; was MTTH 100 years).

title: Boarded

title: A noble prize

title: Taken by pirates
summary: A player liege or close kin hears of the capture and may pay the ransom at once to have the captive sent home, or leave them to the usual haggling. pirate lord.

summary: Hidden upkeep. A pirate lord's lost eye, hand or leg makes the crew fear and admire him (a modifier per wound). The modifier goes when the wound heals or the lord is no longer a pirate. DR_pirates.106 - 107).

title: The First Mate takes the ships
summary: Hidden. When a pirate lord dies and his heir inherits, the First Mate of his house takes every county and every lesser title but the primary one, and is paid for it. The heir is told (pirate.31). pirate lord. Fired from on_new_holder_inheritance (wh_on_actions).

title: A new Pirate Lord
summary: The heir learns the crews have sworn to the First Mate. A player may stay with the empty name, or take up the First Mate's life instead.

title: Fitting out the fleet
summary: Hidden. Hands the new captain the fleet (pirate.40).

title: The fleet sails
summary: Hidden. A Pirate Legend gives a courtier ships and a crew of cutthroats and sends them out to plunder in the Legend's name (the plunder fleet decision in wh_pirate_decisions.txt, via pirate.39). The captain leaves the court with a landless title, a raiding host, a fleet and two mates, and pays tribute to the Legend (with Jade Dragon, so the fleet will not raid its own patron and can be called to the Legend's wars). The booty is shared once a year (pirate.41).

title: Weighing the plunder
summary: Hidden. Once a year the captain takes stock. A fleet that is sunk or scattered, a captain in chains or a captain who has won land of their own is finished (pirate.44). A captain whose patron is dead keeps the ships and turns free raider (pirate.43). Otherwise the patron's share goes home (pirate.42), the captain may turn on the patron (pirate.43; likelier for the ambitious, the greedy and the disloyal), and after five years at sea the captain may come home with the last of the hoard (pirate.45).

title: The patron's share
summary: The captain's purser brings the patron half of what the fleet has taken this year. A good year raises the patron's name among the Brethren.

title: The fleet turns rogue
summary: Hidden. The captain keeps the ships and the plunder and sails for themself, and from now on is a free raider like any other (the raiding adventurers of WHG_adventurer_events.txt, adventurer.10): one day they will want land of their own. A living patron is told (pirate.46) and loses the tribute.

title: The fleet is lost
summary: Hidden. The fleet is sunk, scattered or its captain taken, or the captain won land of their own. The host disbands and the fleet's title goes; a free captain at sea goes home to the patron's court. The patron hears of it unless the captain is now a landed ruler.

title: Home with the hoard
summary: Hidden. After years of plunder the captain sails home and tells the patron (pirate.48), who takes the hoard and welcomes the captain back.

title: The fleet turns rogue
summary: The patron learns the captain has kept the ships and the plunder.

title: The fleet is lost
summary: The patron hears that the fleet is sunk, scattered, or its captain taken.

title: Home with the hoard
summary: The captain lays the last of the hoard at the patron's feet: most of what the fleet still holds, and a name among the Brethren. The fleet's title goes and the host disbands; the captain returns to court.

title: Sack the holding
summary: The raider's men want to plunder a stormed holding. Plunder it: gold by the holding (a city 50 and some learning, a temple 40 and piety, a castle 30 and prestige, a tribe 15), a Lizardmen temple-city more learning and gold; a building burns and the holder and his liege are furious. Or take the holder's people as hostages: courtiers in the holding are taken or killed, the holder taken half the time.

title: Praag falls
summary: Hidden. A servant of Chaos wins a siege of a Praag holding: the city has fallen. If the curse was eased, it comes back at once.

title: Praag changes hands
summary: Hidden. A servant of Chaos taking the county counts as the fall. A free ruler taking it after the fall brings down the curse (praag.3).

title: The Curse of Praag
summary: The city is free again, but what the Chaos sorcerers did to it does not leave. Faces in the walls, madness, and the richest craftsmen in Kislev.

title: The curse returns
summary: Hidden. Every five years: when the Duma's rebuilding has worn off, the curse comes back.

title: The city takes another mind
summary: A courtier who lives in cursed Praag begins to hear the walls. Send them to the Ice Witches for healing, or let it run its course.

title: A child of the walls
summary: A child is born with the mark of the curse on them. Hide them, send them to the Ice Witches, or give them to the Furnace.

title: Faces in the walls
summary: Agonised faces push out of the stones of the palace. Pray, wall them over, or listen to what they say (a secret, and a step towards madness).

title: The Furnace men
summary: The men who smash the risen dead at night ask for gold, oil and men. Help them (Ashes Not Graves on the city; rarely their hammer for the ruler), or send them away.

title: The dead walk in Praag
summary: A district wakes to find its dead walking. Likelier when the Furnace men were sent away. Lead the Furnace men yourself, pay the garrison, or close the district and let it burn.

title: The undertaker
summary: One of Praag's undertakers is found raising what he should be burning. Burn him, take him into service, or drive him out.

title: The silversmiths' street
summary: The jewellers of Praag offer a commission. Pay for a fine piece (one time in four, once a lifetime, a Praag filigree chain), or decline.

title: The Observatory
summary: An astronomer of the old Observatory has read the stars over Kislev. Fund the readings, or send him back to his tower.

title: The missing servants
summary: Servants of the great houses go missing in the night. Look into it (the hunt begins), or let it be.

title: Never at dawn prayers
summary: A boyar of the Duma never comes to the dawn prayers, and never to a daytime feast. Keep watching (praag.42), or drop it.

title: The portrait
summary: In the boyar's house hangs a portrait of his great-grandfather. It is the boyar, to the last grey hair. The truth comes out (praag.43).

title: The boyars who do not age
summary: The vampire boyars are found out: the Upirnovs (von Carstein blood) or the Kalashinivik sisters (Lahmians). Purge them with the Circle of the Bear, bargain for gold and secrets (one of them stays at court), or be drawn in as their living thrall.

title: The Upirnov captain
summary: A pale boyar of the Upirnovs offers to keep the peace in Praag's streets. He is very good at it. Take him into service (a hidden vampire at court, Praag quieter for twenty years), or decline.

title: A Vasilikov's claim
summary: A Vasilikov arrives with a chest of old charters: his house, he says, held a quarter of Praag before the Tzarina's time. Recognise the claim (he joins the court with a claim on a city of Praag), refuse him, or throw him in the cells.

title: An opera about the reign
summary: The Opera House offers to stage an opera about the ruler. Commission it (a triumph, or a scandal if the librettist mocks you), or decline.

title: The diva
summary: The prima donna of the season wants a patron. Invite her to court, send flowers and jewels, or ignore her.

title: Murder in the boxes
summary: A boyar is found dead in his box during the third act, drained white. Investigate (a clever ruler may find the vampire boyars, praag.41), hush it up, or blame the Ungols.

title: The cult in the opera house
summary: Under the stage of the old opera house a Chaos cult meets between performances. Raid it (martial: the cult broken and doom eased a little, but the season is lost), let the Court Chekist break it quietly (intrigue), or close the house for a season and hope.

title: The Z'ra heirs
summary: When the crown of Kislev is weak, the heirs of the old Z'ra rulers come to Praag's lord with Ungol swords behind them. Champion them (stand for independence with the factions; a Z'ra heir joins the court), betray them to the Tzar(ina) (favour, gold, and the duchy of Praag if the crown holds it), or send them away.

title: The Organ of Praag
summary: Each year the organist hears the organ and sinks one step deeper into madness (lunatic_1, then 2, then 3, with the lunatic_counter of WHG_mutation_events.txt), and grows lustful. They may also lay down the post instead. Stops once the organist is raving mad. the flag organist_of_praag comes from the title's gain_effect.

title: Study the myths
summary: The ruler may spend the next months on the faith's holy books, or, in a faith without them, on the tales its priests tell. Studying leads to theology.2; refusing loses a little piety and any study begun.

title: What the study taught
summary: Months of study bring three years of Ancient Wisdom and a step on the theologian's road (theology_study_step_effect).

title: A priest takes notice

title: The priest writes
summary: Hidden bounce so that the friendship event shows the priest as FROM.

title: Letters on holy matters
summary: The ruler and the priest become friends.

title: A holy site in the realm
summary: One of the faith's holy sites lies in the ruler's realm, held by another. A visit costs some gold and is answered in theology.21.

title: At the holy site
summary: The visit brings piety, perhaps zeal (or an end to cynicism), a step on the theologian's road, and rarely a shrine token to bring home (theology_shrine_token_effect).

title: Life in the light of the gods
summary: The ruler reflects on how the gods and their enemies shape a life. Deeper study is a step on the theologian's road; turning away ends any study begun and leaves the ruler cynical.

title: Other gods in the realm
summary: Hidden. A student of a tolerant faith (theology_tolerant_faith_trigger) with no sympathy yet looks at a subject of another such faith group (theology.41).

title: The other believer
summary: Hidden bounce so that theology.42 shows the other believer as FROM.

title: More alike than different?
summary: The ruler gains sympathy for the other believer's faith group, or condemns it for piety.

title: The silent gods
summary: A believer of a scripture faith no longer feels the gods. They may turn cynical (a zealot loses the zeal instead), hold to the faith at the risk of melancholy, or burn with new zeal (a cynic loses the cynicism instead).

title: A scholar of the faith
summary: A Religious Philosopher with no lifestyle trait may become a theologian, a believing one or a cynical one, with a nickname to match; or choose another path.

title: A vision
summary: A stressed or melancholy believer is lifted by a vision in the voice of their faith: the Old World and most faiths, Chaos, Araby, the Dawi and the greenskins. Stress and melancholy are lost.

title: A listless mind
summary: A tired believer may withdraw into prayer for one to three weeks (theology.92 ends it).

title: Out of the hermit's cave
summary: The hermit comes back with one vice shed (drink, gluttony, sloth, an addiction, or lust in a faith that frowns on it), a cure (sight, the pox, leprosy, rarely and only with supernatural events on), a lunatic's mind quieted (or possessed), or, in a faith that scorns chastity, chastity shed. Every outcome may bring temperance and diligence (theology_seclusion_gains_effect).

title: The seclusion ends
summary: Hidden. Ends the seclusion whatever happened, then shows what it brought (theology.91).

title: A friend of another faith
summary: A ruler with sympathy for another faith befriends one of its followers at court. Was five MTTH events of 300 months, one per vanilla faith.

title: The tactless zealot
summary: A zealous, wrathful lord without tact (diplomacy below 5) and above count insults every unbeliever in the realm (opinion -insulted for a year). Was MTTH 300 months.

title: Arabyan tolerance
summary: A calm Arabyan ruler comes to tolerate the Old World faiths of the merchants and sailors in the ports (sympathy_old_world_group). Twice as likely for the cynical and for Mutazilites. Was MTTH 1200 months, for vanilla Muslims (Jews and Christians), so it never fired.

title: Kill them all
summary: A ruler fighting a crusade who storms a city held by heretics of their own faith may let the soldiers loose (cruel, 30 gold, two buildings burn and each of the holder's courtiers in the city has a 50% chance to die, the holder too) or hold them back (maybe kind). (100 in 550).

title: The heralds are ready
summary: The host chooses the size of the tourney or thinks better of it. A local tourney is open to counts and up, a regional one to dukes and up, a grand one to kings and up. The lists open in 30 days (tourney.10).

title: An invitation to ride
summary: A rider is asked to the lists. Declining costs a knight more than a lord who outranks the host. A player may ask never to be bothered again with this size or with any tourney.

title: An invitation to watch
summary: A lord who will not ride is asked to sit in the stands.

title: The lists are raised
summary: Thirty days on, the guests have come. A host caught in a real war must call the tourney off and gets most of the money back; otherwise the lists open (tourney.20) and every guest may meet something around the lists (tourney.50).

title: The tourney is called off
summary: Word comes from : the tourney of is called off. The pavilions are struck and the knights ride home with their lances unbroken.

title: The host dies
summary: The tourney dies with its host. Every guest gets word (tourney.13).

title: Word that the tourney is over
summary: is dead, and the tourney at has died with . The pennants hang black and the knights ride home in silence.

title: Safety catch
summary: Clears whatever a broken chain left behind: a host whose tourney still runs 150 days after the opening, or a guest whose host is dead or no longer holds a tourney 200 days after accepting.

title: The lists are drawn
summary: A player rider learns how many knights ride and that the first tilts are called for tomorrow.

title: The field
summary: Fewer than four riders: hedge knights ride in to make up the numbers. More than sixteen: the heralds' qualifying runs send the weakest AI riders home. The player riders are told (tourney.15) and the first round is called (tourney.21).

title: A new round
summary: One rider left: the champion (tourney.30). Nobody left: the tourney simply ends (tourney.34). Otherwise marks the final (two riders) or the semi-finals (three or four) and starts the pairing (tourney.22).

title: The heralds call the next pair
summary: Two or more riders still unpaired this round: one of them draws a foe (tourney.23), which calls this event again. One left over rides on with a bye. Then the host waits for the tilts to finish (tourney.24).

title: A rider draws a foe
summary: Pairs ROOT with another unpaired rider. A player in the pair chooses how to ride (tourney.25); between two AI riders the tilt is run at once. Then the heralds call the next pair (tourney.22).

title: Waiting on the tilts
summary: While a player still has to ride, the host waits (every 3 days, at most 60). A pair left hanging after that withdraws. Then the next round is called (tourney.21).

title: The herald calls my name
summary: A player rider faces the foe drawn. Ride for glory, pray to the Lady (the Lady's faith: one time in three she grants her blessing), offer a purse to a greedy foe to fall (intrigue 10), or yield. (set from FROM when the foe drew ROOT).

title: A purse to fall
summary: A player rider is offered gold to lose the tilt, which is then run.

title: I win the tilt
summary: Tells a player who unhorsed the foe and how the foe fell.

title: I lose the tilt
summary: Tells a player how the fall went.

title: A rider falls badly
summary: The host and the players at the tourney hear that a rider was crippled or killed. They may ask to hear no more of it this tourney. is the fallen rider, event_target:tourney_tilt_winner the other.

calls: tourney.31; tourney.32; tourney.33; tourney.34; tourney.35; tourney.36; tourney.40
title: The champion is crowned
summary: The last rider in the lists is champion. The champion, runner-up and beaten semi-finalists get their places (tourney.31 - tourney.33), the host hears (tourney.35), player kin of the champion and runner-up hear (tourney.36), and at a regional or grand tourney the champion names the Queen of Love and Beauty (tourney.40). The tourney ends ten days on (tourney.34).

title: Champion of the tourney
summary: Gold, fame, a medal and the host's favour. A champion of a grand or regional tourney may win a charger or the Champion's Lance, once in a life.

title: Runner-up
summary: In the final tilt had the better of me, but no one else at could unhorse me. Second place is no shame.

title: Beaten in the semi-finals
summary: I rode as far as the last four at before I was unhorsed. Not the wreath, but a showing the heralds will remember.

title: The tourney is over
summary: The host earns fame for every guest who came and their goodwill; every guest goes home (player guests hear, tourney.37).

title: The host hears who won
summary: The heralds proclaim the champion of my tourney: , the last rider left in the saddle.

title: My kinsman is champion
summary: My  is the champion of the tourney of ! Every herald in the land will cry the name of House .

title: The guests go home
summary: The tourney of is over. After so many days of lances, wine and song, the road home seems very quiet.

title: The champion names the Queen of Love and Beauty
summary: The champion may honour a wife, a betrothed, a lover, or one of four maidens of the realm: a beauty, a daughter of a great house, a daughter of a lord at the tourney or another. Passing over a wife or betrothed insults her.

title: Crowned Queen of Love and Beauty
summary: She takes the honour and the crowd's acclaim. The host and the players at the tourney hear (tourney.42); a champion not wed to her may try his luck (tourney.43).

title: The tourney hears who is queen
summary: The champion has named Queen of Love and Beauty. The crowd cheers as she is crowned with roses.

title: Pursue the queen?
summary: At the feast the champion catches her eye.

title: The champion's advances
summary: , the champion who named me his queen, has been at my side all evening with sweet words and wine. Now he asks to walk with me in the gardens...

title: She is mine
summary: After much wine and many sweet words, , my Queen of Love and Beauty, is mine. The tourney could not have ended better.

title: She turns me away
summary: For all my charm, , my Queen of Love and Beauty, has turned me away. The wreath, it seems, was all she wanted from me.

calls: tourney.51; tourney.52; tourney.54; tourney.57; tourney.58; tourney.59; tourney.60; tourney.62
title: Around the lists
summary: Rolls what happens to a guest during the tourney. Nothing, two times in five; otherwise a lesson (tourney.51), a knighting (tourney.52), a drunken stumble (tourney.54), a boy who wants to be a squire (tourney.57), a hungover squire (tourney.58), training with a squire (tourney.59), a boasting rival (tourney.60) or a Damsel of the Lady (tourney.62).

title: A lesson of the tourney
summary: Something at the tourney changes the guest: lost or found nerve, a night in the tents, the pox, drink, swordsmanship, or a little more or less skill at intrigue, stewardship or diplomacy. The lesson is the flag tourney.50 set.

title: Knighted in the lists
summary: A knight of Bretonnia offers to knight a rider of the Lady's faith who rode well. Accepting makes him a Knight Errant; the host hears (tourney.53).

title: A knight is made at my tourney
summary: For bold showing in the lists of my tourney, has been dubbed a Knight Errant before the whole crowd.

title: Drunk in the lists
summary: A drunkard rider stumbles out for his tilt and falls off his own horse. The host decides whether that is funny (tourney.55).

title: The host and the drunkard
summary: Laugh it off or call it an outrage. Either way the rider leaves the lists (tourney.56).

title: Out of the lists
summary: The drunkard is out: a host who laughed softens the blow, an angry one makes it a scandal (the drunken_tournament modifier for good).

title: A boy who wants to be a squire
summary: A peasant boy of twelve has held the knight's horse and polished his armour all week and begs to serve. He may be taken in as a ward.

title: A hungover squire
summary: The knight's squire spent the night in the ale tents and the camp followers' wagons and cannot stand. Laugh, scold or beat him. the ward.

title: Training with a squire
summary: Between the jousts the knight drills a ward at the lance and the sword. The ward may become a better fighter.

title: A boast at the feast
summary: Another rider boasts that he has won more jousts than ROOT and mocks his seat. ROOT laughs it off, makes him a rival or throws down the gauntlet: a duel by the rules of the duel engine (duel.1). is the boaster.

title: My boast made an enemy
summary: My boasting at the feast has not gone down well with , who swore before the whole hall to make me eat my words in the lists.

title: A Damsel of the Lady
summary: A Damsel of the Grail walks among the pavilions and stops before ROOT. A rider who kneels may receive the Lady's blessing for his next tilt.

title: Gold rush
summary: A mine not tapped lately strikes a rich vein: three years of income (300 to 3000 gold; vanilla gave ten years, up to 10000). Not again in that province for 10 to 50 years.

title: The mine runs dry
summary: A working gold mine is exhausted. A new vein turns up in 10 to 60 years (goldmine.11).

title: A new vein is found
summary: Tells whoever owns the province by then. (Vanilla defined this as a character event but fired it as a province event, so a dry mine never recovered.)

title: The mine works again
summary: Word has come from : the old gold mine is working again! Prospectors cutting a new gallery broke into a vein nobody knew was there, and the carts are already...

title: Gold drives up prices
summary: The flood of gold raises prices in the mine's province. Live with it for ten years, pay to soften it for four, or (cruel rulers) send soldiers to take the gold back. (Vanilla could pick any province of the demesne.)

title: The Geheimnisnacht Ball
summary: On startup, once a game (also curses the Cursed Company's first captain, undead.14): in a 2010 start, every living Sylvanian lord of Vlad's realm gets his invitation (undead.2). Vlad, if a player, hears how the night went (undead.3).

title: An invitation to Drakenhof
summary: A living lord of Sylvania attends Vlad's ball. He may take the Blood Kiss and become a von Carstein (from_makes_root_vampire_effect), kneel as a living thrall of the Court of Sylvania, or refuse.

title: The ball is over
summary: Vlad, a player, hears how the night went.

title: The barrow opens
summary: A master of the dead breaks open an old barrow and calls its champion back. One time in twenty the barrow held a king: a Wight King, who may bring his tomb blade.

title: The leash breaks
summary: A wight whose employer is no master of the dead, and serves none, falls back into dust (the captain of the Cursed Company is cursed, not bound, and lasts). Fired a day after a master dies (undead.12), so the wight is already at the heir's court, and every five years as a sweep.

title: A master of the dead dies
summary: The wights of his court are checked a day later (undead.11).

title: Dust
summary: The new master learns that a wight of the court has fallen into dust.

title: The captain of the Cursed Company
summary: Whoever leads the Cursed Company is a wight: the curse takes him the day he takes the banner. Fired for a new holder of d_the_cursed_company and at startup (undead.1).

title: Who will work the enchantment?
summary: Finds a necromancer of the realm and a Necrarch of the Brotherhood, then lets the lord choose. The work takes two weeks, two months or four months (undead.51).

title: The ritual is ready
summary: The lord chooses what to bind: a weapon or a suit of armour. The result follows at once (undead.52).

title: The binding
summary: A Necrarch never fails. A necromancer of the realm fails one time in ten, the lord himself one time in seven: the item survives, but the spell is lost. On success the item becomes a necromantic one of its kind (undead_enchant_weapon_effect, undead_enchant_armour_effect).

title: A sire's death
summary: When a vampire ruler dies, every vampire in the realm outside the dynasty (the thralls they made) gets a claim on the dead ruler's primary title (vamp.2).

title: Claim on the sire's title
summary: Hidden. Gives the thrall a claim on FROM's primary title.

title: A thrall asks for a duchy
summary: A landless or baron vampire made by a liege of their dynasty who holds two or more duchies asks the sire for one of them (vamp.4).

title: The thrall's request for a duchy
summary: The sire grants a duchy that is not their primary title (vamp.5) or refuses (vamp.6) and earns the thrall's lasting resentment.

title: Request granted
summary: The sire granted the request. Notification.

title: Request refused
summary: The sire refused the request. Notification.

title: A thrall asks for a county
summary: Like vamp.3, for an unlanded thrall whose sire holds four or more counties.

title: The thrall's request for a county
summary: The sire grants a county that is not their primary title (vamp.5) or refuses (vamp.6).

title: The blood kiss
summary: The turning decision used on someone under 16: the child is told who turned them and the sire is notified (vamp.11).

title: A new child of the night
summary: The child joins the ranks of the undead.

title: Jealous lover
summary: A vampire whose vampire lover keeps other lovers too demands to be the only one (vamp.16). The kind and charitable may choose to share.

title: An ultimatum
summary: The unfaithful lover either sends the other lovers away (vamp.18, vamp.19) or leaves the jealous one (vamp.17).

title: Spurned
summary: The jealous vampire was dropped and becomes the unfaithful lover's rival.

title: Only you
summary: The unfaithful lover chose the jealous vampire. A prestige reward.

title: Cast aside
summary: The other lovers are sent away and become the jealous vampire's rivals. jealous vampire.

title: The ring is taken
summary: Hidden. Passes the Carstein Ring decision on to whoever holds the ring's thief (vamp.21).

title: What to do with the ring?
summary: The holder of a stolen Carstein Ring may keep it (vampires only; gains claims on the old owner's titles if necromantic) or destroy it. Players hear about it (vamp.22 or vamp.612).

title: The ring has a new master
summary: Another vampire has taken the Carstein Ring. Notification for players.

title: The ring thief: the plotter's chance
summary: The head of a plot to steal the Carstein Ring sees an opening and hires a thief, paid by the plot backers, from their own purse or with their own cunning (learning). The thief strikes a month later (vamp.30).

title: The ring thief: a backer's chance
summary: A backer of the ring plot finds a thief and tells the plotter (vamp.35) or asks the plotter for funds (vamp.27).

title: Funds for the thief
summary: The plotter is asked to pay for the thief (vamp.28) or refuses (vamp.29).

title: Funds received
summary: The backer has the money and sends the thief in (vamp.30).

title: No funds
summary: The plotter refused to pay: the backer pays alone or gives up.

title: A touch in the death-sleep

title: Robbed, and the thief is known
summary: The ring is gone and the target knows who sent the thief, who may vanish with it (vamp.42) or keep it (vamp.21).

title: Robbed by an unknown thief
summary: The ring is gone; the plotters may keep it (vamp.21) or lose the thief (vamp.42).

title: The thief is caught
summary: The target wakes, catches the thief and learns the plotter's name.

title: The thief escapes
summary: The target wakes in time, but the thief escapes empty-handed.

title: A backer has a plan
summary: A backer found a thief and asks the plotter to go ahead (vamp.36).

title: Go ahead
summary: The plotter approves and the thief is sent (vamp.30).

title: The plot moves
summary: The other backers hear that the thief will act within a month.

title: Success, but exposed
summary: The ring is taken, but the plotter's part is known.

title: Success, unseen
summary: The ring is taken and nobody knows who sent the thief.

title: Failure, and exposed
summary: The thief was caught and named the plotter; the plot is revealed.

title: Failure, unseen
summary: The thief fled empty-handed; the plotters may try again.

title: The thief has vanished
summary: The thief disappeared with the ring, which is lost. Necromantic thieves lose prestige.

title: The Red Duke rises
summary: At game start the Red Duke of Aquitaine rises: retinues of Black Knights, Grave Guard and Blood Knights, and for the AI money and a Blood Knight host to start the war at once.

title: The band grows
summary: A Blood Dragon war band gathers new fledglings, bringing its founder prestige.

title: Spoils for the Grand Master
summary: A Blood Dragon mercenary captain sends trinkets from the quest to the master of the order (vamp.53). About once in 30 years per captain.

title: Tribute from the quest
summary: The master of the order receives the spoils, sometimes the blade of a fallen champion (artifact vamp_quest_trophy).

title: A worthy recruit
summary: A Blood Dragon mercenary captain picks a strong young courtier, or a child, of the employer's court, turns them and takes them away. The employer (vamp.55) and the band's founder (vamp.56) are told. About once in 30 years per captain.

title: A child stolen
summary: The employer learns that the mercenary turned and took one of the court.

title: A new knight of the order
summary: The band's founder learns of the new recruit.

title: The Blood Dragons dig in
summary: The Blood Dragons have started to occupy a province with a decision; a fortress will rise there in 250 days (vamp.58) unless the province is freed.

title: A Blood Dragon fortress
summary: If the occupation held, a castle is built in the province for the Blood Dragon.

title: Waking from hibernation
summary: Hidden. Clears hidden_hibernated_strigoi from the capital of a ruler who is no longer resting (woken by any event or decision).

title: Ghouls gather

title: The muster goes on
summary: Hidden. While the Strigoi invasion is prepared, roll for the next arrival each month (vamp_strigoi_muster_effect).

title: You waited too long
summary: The invasion was not launched in time: the gathered host leaves.

title: A great warband
summary: A large host joins the invasion of Strygos.

title: A Strigoi lord
summary: Another Strigoi pledges himself to the invasion and brings his own ghouls.

title: More arrive
summary: A small force joins the invasion of Strygos.

title: The AI attacks
summary: Hidden. An AI that prepared the invasion declares the war on an independent ruler holding the old lands of Strygos.

title: Strygos restored by a Strigoi
summary: A Strigoi restores the empire of Strygos (e_strygos) and Mourkain becomes the capital. The Lahmian queen (vamp.72) and the other Strigoi (vamp.73) hear of it; the new emperor may revive the old ways later (vamp.74).

title: Strygos restored by the Strigany
summary: A mortal Strigany restores Strygos (e_strygos_2), as in vamp.70.

title: The Lahmians failed
summary: The Lahmian queen hears that Strygos has risen again and loses prestige.

title: Strygos reborn
summary: A Strigoi ruler may swear fealty to the new Strygos (always if a Strigoi rules it).

title: The old ways
summary: The emperor of Strygos may take the old Strygan culture and faith. If so, Strigany provinces in Strygos slowly turn Strygan (vamp.75, vamp.76).

title: Strygan once more
summary: A Strigany province in Strygos takes up the old Strygan customs.

title: The Strigany return
summary: Strigany settlers come back to a province of Strygos held by a Strigany.

title: Strygos is resettled
summary: Hidden. Every five years each province of the emperor's realm in Strygos may turn Strygan (vamp.75) or Strigany (vamp.76), each about once in 60 years.

title: A Strigany caravan
summary: A Strigany caravan sent by a decision asks to trade in a ruler's capital. Welcomed, its leader moves in and reports home (vamp.82); turned away, it goes home empty-handed (vamp.81).

title: Turned away
summary: The caravan came home with nothing.

title: A foothold
summary: The caravan has settled in; the sender gets a share and the season's trade is rolled: good (vamp.83), fair (vamp.86), bad (vamp.88), driven out (vamp.91) or a permanent settlement (vamp.94).

title: A good season
summary: The caravan made a good profit and the Strigany presence grows.

title: The caravan leaves
summary: The host hears that the Strigany have packed up and gone.

title: A fair season
summary: The caravan made a decent profit.

summary: As vamp.84, for a fair season.

summary: Misunderstandings cost the caravan its profit; the host's capital suffers strife (vamp.89).

summary: The host's people grow tired of the Strigany (strigany_strife).

summary: As vamp.84, for a bad season.

summary: The host's people drove the Strigany out.

title: Driven out (sender)
summary: The sender hears the caravan was driven out.

title: A Strigany settlement
summary: The caravan has grown into a tribe holding in the host's capital and swears fealty to the sender.

title: A Strigany settlement (host)
summary: The host learns that the Strigany have taken land in the capital.

title: A Strigany settlement (sender)
summary: The sender hears of the new outpost.

title: A caravan leader dies
summary: Hidden. A dead Strigany caravan leader's caravan leaves the host's capital.

title: A caravan host dies
summary: Hidden. A dead host's caravans pass to the heir.

title: Subjects for study
summary: A Necrarch on a thrall raid takes a capital: kill everyone (the owner and their top liege are told, vamp.101 and vamp.102), take them as test subjects (vamp.103) or leave them.

title: A province scourged
summary: The province's owner hears that the Necrarch razed it.

title: A province scourged (liege)
summary: The top liege hears that the Necrarch razed one of their provinces.

title: Subjects taken
summary: The owner or top liege hears that the Necrarch took prisoners.

summary: A Necrarch with enough subjects studies them (vamp.106 to vamp.109) or makes servants of them (vamp.110 to vamp.113).

summary: Learning +1, and sometimes the notes are worth keeping (artifact vamp_necrarch_journal).

title: A good night of study
summary: Piety +500.

title: An adequate night of study
summary: Piety +250.

title: A frustrating night of study
summary: Piety +100.

title: Monstrous servants
summary: The subjects become a big pack of war beasts.

title: Monstrous servants (few)
summary: A small pack of war beasts.

title: Ghouls
summary: The subjects become ghouls.

title: Undead slaves
summary: The subjects become undead.

title: A commission
summary: Hidden. Passes a request for a magic item on to the Necrarch (vamp.116).

title: A request for a magic item
summary: The Necrarch takes the commission (commission.1) or refuses (vamp.117).

title: Commission refused
summary: The Necrarch refused to craft the item.

title: The Jade decay
summary: Every five years a Jade vampire must gaze into a Dark Crystal (their own or their top liege's, vamp.121) or decay a step: jade_degradation 1 to 4, madness and lost skills.

title: Basking in the crystal
summary: The crystal heals the decay and may give Lore of Heavens. A ruler may then receive a demand or a vision from the Dragon-Emperor (vamp.122).

summary: Hidden. Rolls what the crystal shows: a trinket demanded (vamp.123), a quest (vamp.124), visions that teach or break the mind (vamp.125 to vamp.138), or relief from madness (vamp.139) and mutation (vamp.140).

title: A tribute shipped
summary: Treasures vanish from the treasury, sent to an unknown place on the vampire's own orders.

title: A summons
summary: The vampire is compelled to leave on a quest (questing); it ends in vamp.141, vamp.142 or vamp.143.

title: A glimpse of the Heavens
summary: Magic power grows a step (Lore of Heavens).

title: The sound of the universe
summary: Learning +1.

title: The Firebringer's dreams
summary: Technology points.

title: Overwhelmed
summary: Too much knowledge: incapable.

title: Stared too long
summary: Learning -1 and a step towards madness.

title: The great wyrms see me
summary: A living mortal goes mad (lunatic_3).

title: Burned by the light
summary: A living mortal is consumed by the crystal and dies.

title: The Dragon Gods revealed
summary: A living mortal converts to the Dragon Gods.

title: The Ordainer's eloquence
summary: Diplomacy for some years (jade_plus_diplomacy).

title: Memories of ancient battles
summary: Martial for some years (jade_plus_martial).

title: The laws of the Heavens
summary: Stewardship for some years (jade_plus_stewardship).

title: The Sleeping One's secrets
summary: Intrigue for some years (jade_plus_intrigue).

title: The Firegiver's shadow
summary: Learning for some years (jade_plus_learning).

title: The eyes of the Dragon-Emperor
summary: A Dragon God worshipper in debt gets piety income for a while.

title: Clarity of mind
summary: Madness recedes (lunatic_counter -10).

title: Clarity of body
summary: Mutations burn away (mutation_counter -10), at the cost of a wound.

title: Home from the quest
summary: The quest is over without harm.

title: Home, badly hurt
summary: The vampire comes back wounded and maimed.

title: Lost on the quest
summary: The vampire never returns (younger than 500 only).

title: The hypnotic stare
summary: A Jade vampire's gaze ensnares the target: usually friendship and a hold over them; the clever and the magically gifted may resist.

title: Fed upon
summary: The Jade have fed too much in a necromantic province (jade_depopulation).

title: The living resist
summary: A living province of a Jade ruler resists the feasts (jade_mayhem).

title: The Jade feed
summary: Hidden. Every five years each province of a Jade vampire ruler may be fed upon (vamp.146, about once in 60 years) or resist (vamp.147, about once in 40 years). Small realms and many Jade courtiers make it likelier.

title: The great feast
summary: With a decision the Jade round up a province: partly cleansed (vamp.151), emptied (vamp.152) or risen in revolt (vamp.153).

summary: The province is fed upon and loses a building (jade_depopulation); another province recovers.

summary: The province is emptied; Saurus come to settle it later (vamp.154).

summary: The province rises against the Jade (jade_mayhem and a revolt).

title: Saurus settlers
summary: Lost Saurus settle the empty province and take the ruler's faith.

title: Raiders feed

title: Drained by the Jade
summary: The owner hears that the Jade fed on their people.

title: Drained by the Jade (liege)
summary: The top liege hears the same.

title: A Dark Crystal found

title: A crystal found
summary: A player hears that a Dark Crystal was found.

title: Sha'shala's new army
summary: Sha'shala relinks with the Dragon-Emperor and receives an army from Cathay to conquer Lustria.

title: Naparaya's reward
summary: Naparaya destroyed the renegade Jade and is rewarded with an army; more if Shdroi So'sou was sent back to Cathay.

title: Shdroi So'sou judged
summary: The captured Imperial Scribe is sent to the Heavenly City and never returns.

title: Shdroi So'sou escapes
summary: The Scribe charms the guards and flees to a ruler of his faith.

title: Forsaken by the Dragons
summary: A ruler who turned one Jade too many is cast out of the Dragon faith and becomes vampiric, with their Jade children.

title: The spiders are angry
summary: A Mahtmasi frightens goblin invaders worshipping the Spider God: they end the war (vamp.171) or march on and lose piety (vamp.172).

title: The goblins flee
summary: The Mahtmasi's signs drove the goblins away.

title: The goblins march on
summary: The goblins ignored the warning.

title: Reborn as a Mahtmasi
summary: The blood kiss of the Mahtmasi worked: the victim rises again.
