title: The bloodlines stir
summary: Every five years: a vampire who has left their society (or was made a vampire by some path that missed the join) is put back, a member may get one of their bloodline's flavour events, and the head of the Court of Sylvania ends the Feud of the Counts once it is twenty years old.

title: Risen in the bloodline
summary: A member has risen a rank.

title: The hunger
summary: The vampire feeds. A servant is safe. Worthy prey (a warrior of the realm) feeds deeper and counts as the Strigoi's deed, but may fight back. A Mahtmasi may instead answer a mortal who came asking, which is the Mahtmasi deed. The Blood Dragons lose Honour for feeding on the helpless.

title: A plea from the blood
summary: A member at war asks the head of the bloodline for help. The head may send gold, lend the dead of their own lands, or refuse.

title: The head answers
summary: The head of the bloodline has sent help (gold or the dead).

title: The head refuses
summary: The head of the bloodline will not help.

title: A thrall's gift
summary: A living thrall offers their blood to their vampire liege. Drinking deep heals the vampire and leaves the thrall weak; drinking sparingly is kinder. Either way the service counts as the thrall's deed for rank 2.

title: A daylight errand
summary: The thrall runs an errand for their master where a vampire can't go: into a church, a market at noon, a guild hall. Success earns gold and counts as the thrall's deed; failure leaves them suspected or hurt.

title: The Night of Blood
summary: The trial of the Court: on one night the vampire must raise the dead of a graveyard and drown a village in terror, unseen by the witch hunters. A month later: vampsoc.101.

title: The night ends
summary: The bold choice pays more and fails more often. Success passes the trial; failure means waiting five years to try again.

title: Throw off the mask
summary: A hidden von Carstein reveals what they are to their court.

title: The Feud of the Counts
summary: Vlad von Carstein is dead for good. His get turn on one another: for twenty years every Vampire Lord of the Court is a rival of the others, and the Feud flavour (vampsoc.113) offers claims on each other's lands.

title: Vlad is dead
summary: Every Vampire Count and Lord hears that the master is gone. The Lords become rivals of each other.

title: The Feud ends
summary: Twenty years on, the Feud of the Counts is over. Whoever leads the Court now leads it in earnest. sweep).

title: A rival Count
summary: During the Feud, a rival Vampire Lord holds lands you could take. Press a claim, or make a pact against the others. a rival von Carstein ruler.

calls: vampsoc.113; vampsoc.121; vampsoc.122; vampsoc.123; vampsoc.124; vampsoc.125; vampsoc.126
title: von Carstein flavour
summary: Picks one Court of Sylvania flavour event (vampsoc.121 - vampsoc.126, and the Feud, vampsoc.113).

title: A hungry Count
summary: A lesser vampire of the Court covets your lands and has been courting your vassals. Pay him off in Blood, or humble him in public.

title: The restless graveyard
summary: The dead of a village graveyard stir on their own. Bind them to your levies, or let them sleep.

title: The priest who would not drink
summary: A priest at your court has noticed that you never take the sacrament and never stand in the sun. Silence him, or wait.

title: Tribute to Drakenhof
summary: The Master of Court demands tribute from every Count. Pay, or refuse and be remembered for it.

title: A mortal begs the kiss
summary: A mortal noble at your court begs to be made one of the undying. Bind him with the promise, or turn him down.

title: An envoy returns
summary: Your envoy comes home from a mortal court with a treaty, and perhaps the Seal of Drakenhof.

title: Sylvania Reborn
summary: The Master of Court works the great ritual over the land of Sylvania. Two to three years later: vampsoc.131.

title: The land answers
summary: Every county of Sylvania held by the Master or their vassals is bound to the dead, and the Master is bound to the land. For life.

title: A champion's challenge
summary: The Blood Dragon rides out to challenge a famed mortal champion. A win earns Honour (and for a squire, counts as the deed for rank 2); a loss costs Honour and blood.

title: Challenge to the Grand Master
summary: A Blood Dragon Lord challenges the Grand Master before the knights of the Order. The victor leads the Ordo Draconis. Grand Master, saved by vampsoc_challenge_grand_master.

title: Unseated
summary: The Grand Master has lost the challenge and the Order.

title: The code of Abhorash
summary: A knight with no Honour left to lose is stripped of rank and sent back among the squires to earn it again.

calls: vampsoc.171; vampsoc.172; vampsoc.173; vampsoc.174; vampsoc.175; vampsoc.176
title: Blood Dragon flavour
summary: Picks one Ordo Draconis flavour event (vampsoc.171 - vampsoc.176).

title: A squire's oath
summary: A young mortal knight begs to serve the Blood Dragon and one day earn the blood. Training him takes time and gives Honour; turning him away is safe.

title: An insult at court
summary: A mortal knight mocks the Order at a feast. A Blood Dragon cannot let it pass: fight him, or let a lesser knight take the insult for the Order.

title: The red thirst
summary: After a battle the thirst rises. Master it as Abhorash taught, or glut yourself on the dying.

title: A worthy foe falls
summary: Word comes of a great champion slain by the Blood Dragon's hand, or by a knight of their household. The Order honours the deed; there is a small chance of the Dragon Plate of the Order.

title: The tourney at the Blood Keep
summary: The Grand Master summons the knights of the Order to the lists. Attending earns Honour and the Grand Master's regard, at the risk of a wound.

title: The dream of Abhorash
summary: In the day-sleep the Blood Dragon dreams of Abhorash, who mastered the thirst on the peaks of the World's Edge. Patience or fury.

title: The trail of Abhorash
summary: The Grand Master leaves the Blood Keep to find the founder's trail in the World's Edge Mountains. Two to three years later: vampsoc.181.

title: The dragon of the peaks
summary: High in the mountains the Grand Master faces the beast Abhorash himself once fought. Win, and the trail leads on (vampsoc.182); lose, and the quest ends with wounds and shame.

title: Abhorash's peak
summary: The Grand Master reaches the peak where Abhorash conquered the thirst, and there learns his secret. A blessing for life, and every knight of the Order gains Honour.

title: Assisting mortals
summary: A Lahmian Queen helps a mortal ruler at war, with gold or with sellswords under her own banner. The mortal is caught in the web of the Sisterhood (the Tithe of the Houses counts them).

title: Sellswords from a friend
summary: The sellswords paid for by the Lahmian arrive at the mortal's capital and serve until the peace.

title: The Tithe of the Houses
summary: Every Lahmian house and every mortal in the web pays the Queen of Mysteries her due.

calls: vampsoc.221; vampsoc.222; vampsoc.223; vampsoc.224; vampsoc.225; vampsoc.226
title: Lahmian flavour
summary: Picks one Lahmian Sisterhood flavour event (vampsoc.221 - vampsoc.226).

title: A witch hunter asks questions
summary: A witch hunter has heard rumours about the beautiful lady who is never seen by day. Mislead him with Favour, have him killed (risky), or flee the court for a while.

title: A rival Sister
summary: Another Sister has been whispering against you to the Queen. Outwit her, or buy her silence.

title: A letter from the Silver Pinnacle
summary: The Queen of Mysteries asks a service: gold for a bribe in a distant court. Obey for Favour, or ignore her at a cost.

title: An admirer
summary: A mortal admirer begs for the honour of feeding you. Drink, or toy with them for the court's amusement.

title: The masked ball
summary: You host a masked ball, and the princes of the realm dance with you until dawn. Favour, and a small chance of the Cameo of Neferata.

title: The portrait
summary: A courtier has found an old portrait of you, painted sixty years ago, and you have not aged a day. Bribe them, kill them, or let them talk.

title: The Great Web
summary: The Queen of Mysteries sets out to bind the courts of the Old World to the Silver Pinnacle. Three to five years later: vampsoc.231.

title: The web is spun
summary: Every Sister gains Favour and the Queen rules the courts from her bed and her letters. For life.

title: The Magnum Opus
summary: The Necrarch begins the great work of their unlife. Two to four years later: vampsoc.251.

title: The work is done
summary: Learning decides the result. Success passes the trial with a reward by field; failure costs five years.

title: The hunt for a relic of Nagash
summary: A Master Necrarch sends an expedition into the deserts of Nehekhara for a relic of the Great Necromancer. Two to three years later: vampsoc.256.

title: The expedition returns
summary: The relic is found (a seat in the Dark Tower can now be claimed), the Tomb Kings drive the expedition off, or the desert takes it.

title: A Wight King rises
summary: A Master Necrarch binds the spirit of a barrow king back into his bones: a Wight King who serves as a commander (wight_rise_effect). He may bring his tomb blade (wight_tomb_blade_effect).

title: A breakthrough
summary: Every twenty years or so a Necrarch's long labour bears fruit.

calls: vampsoc.260; vampsoc.271; vampsoc.272; vampsoc.273; vampsoc.274; vampsoc.275; vampsoc.276
title: Necrarch flavour
summary: The breakthrough when it is due (vampsoc.260), else one Necrarch flavour event (vampsoc.271 - vampsoc.276).

title: A letter from the Tower
summary: Another Necrarch writes to dispute a point of necromantic theory. Answer at length, or ignore them.

title: The apprentice
summary: Your apprentice has made progress, or a terrible mistake.

title: Grave robbing
summary: Your servants need fresh bodies for your work. Rob your own graveyards, or buy corpses from beyond the border.

title: The tower grows
summary: You add a new floor to your tower: a laboratory, an ossuary, a library.

title: Forgotten notes
summary: In an old chest you find your own notes from three centuries ago, and perhaps a copy of a page of the Liber Mortis.

title: The peasants complain
summary: The peasants say the tower's lights burn all night and their dead do not stay buried. Placate them, or ignore them.

title: The Recipe for Nagash
summary: A Lord of the Dark Tower holding a relic of Nagash begins to reconstruct the Great Necromancer's work. Three to five years later: vampsoc.281.

title: The recipe is complete
summary: The Lord has reconstructed the Recipe for Nagash. A permanent mastery of death, and every Necrarch gains Lore.

title: The ghoul court
summary: The trial of the Strigoi: gather a court of ghouls, the cannibal wretches who live among the graves. One to two years later: vampsoc.301.

title: The court gathers
summary: The starving poor make a large court that is hard to hold; the graveyard-eaters make a small one that holds. Success passes the trial.

title: The curse of Ushoran
summary: A Strigoi who has gone hungry loses control and becomes the beast.

calls: vampsoc.310; vampsoc.321; vampsoc.322; vampsoc.323; vampsoc.324; vampsoc.325; vampsoc.326
title: Strigoi flavour
summary: A hungry Strigoi may fall into frenzy (vampsoc.310); otherwise one Strigoi flavour event (vampsoc.321 - vampsoc.326).

title: Scorned by the blood
summary: A vampire of another bloodline has called the Strigoi beasts and grave-eaters before witnesses. Swallow it, or answer in blood.

title: The caravan comes
summary: A Strigany caravan arrives with news, stolen goods and a cart of volunteers for the Strigoi's table.

title: The crypt feast
summary: The ghouls have dug up a fresh graveyard. Join the feast, or keep your dignity.

title: The dream of Strygos
summary: In the day-sleep you walk the marble halls of Strygos before it fell, and Ushoran speaks to you.

title: Digging in the ruins
summary: Your servants dig in the ruins of a Strygan city. Old gold, and perhaps the Bone Crown of Strygos.

title: Hunters on the trail
summary: Vampire hunters have tracked you to your lair. Fight them, or move on.

title: Strygos Reborn
summary: The Heir of Ushoran calls the scattered Strigoi to rebuild the court of Strygos. Three to four years later: vampsoc.331.

title: The court of Ushoran
summary: Strygos lives again in its king. For life, and every Strigoi gains Hunger.

title: The Scribe's Examination
summary: A Crystal Mandarin sits the examination of the Coil, a cruel mirror of the Imperial examinations: three days of questions put by the Sage's serpents.

title: Shedding the skin
summary: The Jade vampire coils in the dark of the crystal chamber and sheds the old skin, and the jade decay with it.

title: The Serpent's Coils
summary: The Serpent Sage winds a mortal ruler in the coils of the Jade Court: tribute now, and a lasting fascination.

calls: vampsoc.371; vampsoc.372; vampsoc.373; vampsoc.374; vampsoc.375; vampsoc.376
title: Jade flavour
summary: Picks one Jade Coil flavour event (vampsoc.371 - vampsoc.376).

title: The Imperial Scribe
summary: An Imperial Scribe arrives to count the taxes of the province. The Jade Coil has always found scribes delicious.

title: The itch beneath the scales
summary: The old skin grows tight. Bask by the crystal, or ignore it.

title: The crystal hums
summary: A small vision in the Dark Crystal: a lesson, or a hunger.

title: A rival Coil
summary: Another Jade vampire tries to hypnotise your servants. A duel of stares.

title: A crystal shard
summary: A servant brings a sliver of dark crystal found in a mountain stream: perhaps the Shard of the Dark Crystal.

title: The Emperor's hunters
summary: Agents of the Dragon Emperor are hunting the serpents again. Fight them in the dark, or slither away.

title: The Celestial Gaze
summary: The Serpent Sage coils around the greatest of the Dark Crystals and gazes at the whole of the heavens. Three to four years later: vampsoc.381.

title: The heavens seen
summary: The Sage has seen everything under heaven. For life, and every Coil gains Venom.

title: The Beloved
summary: The trial of the Carrion Children: a mortal has asked for you. Love them for a year, and then devour them. A year later: vampsoc.401.

title: The end of love
summary: Devour the Beloved and pass the trial, or spare them and fail it.

title: The Vigil at Gwingui
summary: An Elder of the Swarm keeps vigil at the gate of Gwingui, where the shadow realm touches the world. One to two years later: vampsoc.406.

title: What came through the gate
summary: The vigil ends. The gate has accepted the Elder (the mark of the next Big Bokor) or spat them out.

title: Devouring kin
summary: The Mahtmasi eats another vampire, as the Carrion Children do.

title: A dream sent
summary: The Mahtmasi sends a dream to a mortal ruler. They wake longing, and may come asking; or they wake screaming.

calls: vampsoc.421; vampsoc.422; vampsoc.423; vampsoc.424; vampsoc.425; vampsoc.426
title: Mahtmasi flavour
summary: Picks one Carrion Children flavour event (vampsoc.421 - vampsoc.426).

title: The swarm
summary: You come apart into flies and carrion birds and drift over the land, hearing everything.

title: Fire in the night
summary: The villagers have found your resting place and come with torches. The Mahtmasi fear fire above all.

title: A plea at the altar
summary: A mortal has left an offering at your altar and asks for gold, a child or a dead rival.

title: Maatmeses in dreams
summary: The first of the Mahtmasi, who lives now only in dreams, speaks to you.

title: Running water
summary: Your road crosses a river, and running water burns the Mahtmasi. Go the long way around, or be carried across.

title: The bokor's gift
summary: A bokor brings a fetish from the gate of Gwingui: perhaps the Bokor's Fetish itself.

title: Cast out the Westerlanders
summary: The Big Bokor turns the shadow realm against the Westerlanders of Sudenburg and the witch hunters of Samur. Two to three years later: vampsoc.431.

title: The shadows take Sudenburg
summary: The Westerlanders' hold on Sudenburg is broken. The lands of Sudenburg held by the Big Bokor or their vassals are haunted for good; every Mahtmasi gains Offerings.

title: Another bloodline
summary: A vampire ruler of another bloodline holds lands nearby. The bloodlines have hated each other since Lahmia fell, but a pact can serve both. event_target:vampsoc_other is a vampire ruler of another bloodline.

title: The missions of the Order
summary: Hidden. Every other year a member gets a mission from a brother or sister of the Order, a Lorekeeper of his realm or his own apprentice: find an apprentice, build a library, recover a lost text, raid the hoard of a Scrollbearer or watch the stars. The AI mostly settles its missions without the chain.

title: A house of learning
summary: The decision build_library is taken: the member may go on with the work or take his gold back.

title: Where the books shall sleep
summary: Hidden in the castle (safe, but a fire there hurts the household), open to every reader (efficient) or in a guarded house far away (for the cunning and the fearful; on an island when the capital has a port).

title: How great a library
summary: A reading room, a scriptorium, a hall of learning or a library to rival the Grand Temple of Nuln. The greater the plan, the more gold, learning and fittings it takes (one to four of them, verena.13).

title: The fittings of the library
summary: One of the four fittings the plan still lacks: the copyists, the lamps, the bindings or the books themselves. Making do is cheap; the best costs gold and makes a better library. Fires itself again until every fitting of the plan is chosen, then the library is finished (verena.14).

title: The library is finished
summary: Hidden. A learned apprentice adds one level to the library. The level decides the library the member gets (verena.15 or verena.16).

title: A library of my own
summary: Level below 6: a simple library; below 12: a library; else an impressive one, each with knowledge for the realm.

title: The house of learning
summary: Level 18 or more: a grand library; 23 or more: a famous one, spoken of in Nuln and Altdorf.

title: Fire in the library
summary: The lamps of the reading room. In a library inside the castle, someone of the household is burned (a relative's maiming may sadden the member).

title: The rabble at the gate
summary: A Sigmarite rabble-rouser stirs the town against the forbidden books the Verenans are said to hoard. Placate them (a worse library) or ignore them (prestige).

title: Damp and bookworm
summary: The new books have been stored in a damp cellar. Save what can be saved or pay for a dry store (a better library).

title: Mission: build a library (ping)
summary: Hidden. The mission giver writes to the member.

title: Mission: build a library
summary: A brother of the Order, or the member's own apprentice, says he cannot study without a library. Accepting gives the quest and the decision.

title: Mission: the library stands
summary: The quest is done; a better library brings more favor of the Order.

title: Mission: find an apprentice (ping)
summary: Hidden. The mission giver writes to the member.

title: Mission: find an apprentice
summary: A brother boasts of his own apprentice. If the member names none within half a year, a bright servant is found for him (verena.32).

title: A servant with a quick mind
summary: Hidden. Still no apprentice: a young servant of the member's faith and culture turns up with a bright mind and a good trait (never a woman among races without women).

title: The servant (ping)
summary: Hidden. The servant is shown to the member.

title: What about this servant?
summary: The member may make the servant his apprentice (mission done) or keep looking.

title: An apprentice is named
summary: The member names an apprentice himself: the more learned the apprentice, the more favor of the Order.

title: Mission: recover a lost text (ping)
summary: Hidden. The mission giver writes to the member.

title: Mission: recover a lost text
summary: A brother of the Order has an old letter naming three lost texts; he brings the knowledge, the member pays for the expedition.

title: The letter (ping)
summary: Hidden. The mission giver sends the places to the member.

title: Where shall we look?
summary: A tablet in foreign ruins (for players: Nehekhara, Araby or the Border Princes), a scroll in a temple of the realm, a tome at a local antiquarian: the further, the costlier, the rarer and the more favor. Once in a member's life, while no one holds it, the giver may have a map to a sealed archive of Lybaras, the city of scholars, where the Tablet of Lybaras lies; few who go come back.

title: The end of the search
summary: Hidden. The outcome flag on the mission giver picks the event the member gets; the flags are cleared afterwards.

title: The Tablet of Lybaras
summary: The sealed archive is found and the Tablet of Lybaras (emerald_tablet) is carried out of the desert, if no one holds it yet; the Order's greatest favor and a bond with the giver.

title: The tablet in the ruins
summary: Our journey into foreign lands met with no small amount of trouble, but at last we reached the ruins of safely. After a fortnight of digging the servants laid...

title: The scroll in the temple
summary: A generous gift to the temple of persuaded its priest to open the inner chambers to us. We searched every niche and crypt for the hiding place of the scroll,...

title: The tome at the antiquarian
summary: and I went through every shelf and chest of the dusty little shop. For days on end we did nothing but breathe dust and leaf through almanacs, sermons and bad...

title: Nothing but dust
summary: The search fails. After the desert of Lybaras the member suspects the map was forged and the giver becomes his rival.

title: Mission: raid a Scrollbearer's hoard (ping)
summary: Hidden. The mission giver writes to the member.

title: Mission: raid a Scrollbearer's hoard
summary: A brother of the Order names a member who hoards books like the Scrollbearers and shares nothing: the giver's rival, someone both of them dislike or a rich hoarder. Accepting makes the giver the member's companion for the break-in.

title: Find the hoard (router)
summary: Hidden. A hidden or remote library must be found first (verena.53), an open one is entered at once (verena.55).

title: The companion's spies
summary: The companion's spies look for the hidden library; the better his intrigue, the sooner, the better hidden, the later.

title: The hoard is found (ping)
summary: Hidden. Scope: ROOT is the companion, FROM the member.

title: The Knights at the door
summary: The hoarder has hired guards, sometimes a Knight of the Scroll. Bribe them (diplomacy 12; dearer for a hidden library), drug them with a sleeping draught (learning), have the companion lure them away (his intrigue) or turn back. A half-failed draught or distraction lets the raid go on but the guards come back in time (flags guards_wake_up, distraction_failed).

title: Inside the hoard
summary: The guards are bought or asleep. Split up (one carries off books, one wrecks the scriptorium; the companion's share is verena.70 or 72) or stay together. Guards that wake up catch the member (verena.60).

title: The draught fails
summary: The guards never fall asleep: the mission fails and the companion is disappointed.

title: The distraction works
summary: The companion has drawn the guards away; the member alone takes or wrecks.

title: The distraction fails
summary: I have seen many foolish things in my day, but 's distraction may take the prize. began to rattle a chain against the wall and wail like a ghost of the...

title: Caught
summary: The guards catch the member (and an AI companion) taking or wrecking, or the companion's clumsy theft gives them away (flag bad_theft). The hoarder imprisons them and decides their fate (verena.61).

title: Thieves in my library
summary: The hoarder may offer the thief freedom for his secrets (a ransom of the Order's favor) or let him rot.

title: Your secrets for your freedom
summary: The prisoner may pay with his secrets and go free, or refuse.

title: The thief talks
summary: The hoarder gets the prisoner's secrets and frees him.

title: The thief refuses
summary: I barely knew  when they dragged before me. A few days in the dungeon will do that. It seems has grown fond of cell, however, for my generous offer earned me...

title: Left to rot
summary: I had come to the point of begging for water when the guards dragged me out of the cell. I must have fainted, for the next thing I see is the scornful face of...

title: The hoard is opened
summary: The member carries off a book of the Order (a great theft, not against a played hoarder so often), the hoarder's ingredients (a good one) or a purse (an ordinary one), with gold and the Order's favor. Then the hoarder learns of it (verena.67) and the member gets away (verena.75).

title: My books are gone
summary: The hoarder learns of the theft: the book and an ingredient pass to the thief.

title: The scriptorium is wrecked
summary: No book is burned: the member wrecks the hoarder's scriptorium, scatters his catalogue and spoils his work. With a library built, it may be ruined outright (the library is lost); else damaged (gold and ingredients); and a clumsy member may die when the lamp oil catches. Then the hoarder learns of it (verena.69) and the member gets away (verena.75).

title: My scriptorium is wrecked
summary: The hoarder learns of it: his library is lost, or he pays for the damage; or the burned body of the thief is found.

title: The companion takes (router)
summary: Hidden. While the member wrecks, the companion takes: ingredients, a purse, or he is caught and gives them both away (verena.60).

title: The companion's spoils
summary: The companion has taken a fine cinnabar (an ingredient, if the member has none) or some tools; a little of the Order's favor.

title: The companion wrecks (router)
summary: Hidden. While the member takes, the companion wrecks the scriptorium; one time in ten the lamp oil takes him.

title: The companion's work
summary: As I close my satchel I hear a loud crash from the scriptorium. I peer through the doorway, and the sight is a fine one. By the light of 's lantern I see...

title: The companion burns
summary: The lamp oil takes the companion; the member runs and the mission fails.

title: Away into the night
summary: The mission is done. Fond companions become friends, the rest accomplices.

title: The hoarder's flags are cleared
summary: Hidden. Scope: the hoarder.

title: The Blind Maiden
summary: The decision hermetics_perform_scrying: the member ties on a silk blindfold, prays the Blind Maiden over a bowl of still water and asks about battles, the people close to [Root.GetHerHim] or [Root.GetHerHis] power. A rare substance thrown into the water strengthens the vision, but the member no longer chooses what it shows.

title: The vision in the water
summary: The water shows one of three visions of what the member asked about, and the member reads it as a good or a bad omen (a rare substance makes a good reading likelier). The omen waits for the moment that fulfils or belies it: a battle, a birth, a death, a title, a sickness. If nothing does within about four years, a fallback settles it (verena.119 - 121).

title: The battle foretold: glory
summary: In battle a member with a battle omen learns a new way to lead: as foretold, or despite a bad omen. events/WHG_battle_events.txt.

title: The battle foretold: the wound
summary: In battle a member with a battle omen is struck down: as foretold, or despite a good omen. Wounded, crippled or, rarely, killed. events/WHG_battle_events.txt.

title: The child foretold
summary: A parent with a relationship omen meets a newborn who is either clearly gifted (smart or strong, no inborn flaw) or clearly not (an inborn flaw, neither smart nor strong). A good omen and a gifted child, or a bad omen and a dull one, prove the vision right. Was MNM.1204 and 1205, merged.

title: The child foretold (ping)
summary: Hidden. A newborn whose father or mother carries a relationship omen shows itself to them (verena.104).

title: A death foretold (ping)
summary: Hidden. Someone dies, and the people close to [Root.GetHerHim] who carry a relationship omen learn of it: a lover, a friend, a rival, a grown child or a parent, each once (verena.107).

title: A death foretold
summary: A lover, friend, rival, parent or child has died. Grief proves a bad omen right and a good one wrong. The death of a rival does the opposite. Was MNM.1208 - 1212, merged.

title: A pet foretold (ping)
summary: Hidden. A cat or a dog has died, and its owner may carry a relationship omen (verena.109). common/scripted_effects/wh_pet_effects.txt, events/WHG_battle_events.txt and events/WHG_hunting_events.txt.

title: A pet foretold
summary: The owner wonders whether the death of the cat or dog was what the vision was about. Madness makes it a curse, or the owner's own doing.

title: A title foretold
summary: The member gains a title while carrying a power omen. A good omen was right. on_new_holder_inheritance and on_new_holder_usurpation.

title: A loss foretold (ping)
summary: Hidden. A title changes hands while the old holder lives. The new holder checks a day later whether it was a free grant (verena.113). from on_new_holder, on_new_holder_inheritance and on_new_holder_usurpation.

title: A free grant
summary: Hidden. A title granted of free will is no loss foretold. GRANT_LANDED_TITLE_INTERACTION_ACCEPT_EVENT.

summary: A comet over the camp. Lead the boyz as an omen of Gork, drive them as a taskmaster, or (after both) take advice from a snotling who claims the comet chose him, and make him marshal.

title: Guided by Gork or by grog

title: Preach against heresy

title: The sermon
summary: The crowd gathers. Thunder against Chaos (Learning and zeal), name a suspect in the crowd, or preach mercy and vigilance (Diplomacy).

title: The tribunal sits
summary: An Inquisitor-General tries an accused prisoner: burn, force a recantation, or acquit. Fired by the inquisition_hold_tribunal decision.

title: The escort rides home
summary: Two years on, the Knights of the Blazing Sun return to their order.

title: A chapter answers the Border Princes
summary: The chapter a lord of the Border Princes invited sends a hunter. Kislevite lords of Kislev's gods get a Chekist; Myrmidian, Estalian and Tilean lords get the Inquisition; Sigmarite, Ulrican and Taalite lords get the Order of Sigmar three times in four, else a Templar or an Inquisitor; everyone else gets the Templars of Solkan.

title: A hunter at the gate
summary: A wandering witch hunter arrives and offers service, or, if a Templar of Solkan or an Inquisitor, demands residence. Most come from the local chapter; some are Templars or Inquisitors far from home, or hunters of Ulric or Taal. The usual way the rarer hunters reach a court, where they feed the rivalry events (whchapter.10-11). Fired by on_five_year_pulse (random list whchapter_wanderer).

title: Home from the chapterhouse
summary: Four years after train_court_witch_hunter sent him away, the trainee comes home a witch hunter. He joins the local chapter where one answers for his lord's lands and takes the court seat if one is free.

title: The trainee returns
summary: The lord learns that his courtier is back from the chapterhouse.

title: Chapter marks
summary: Members of the Inquisition or the Templars of Solkan who joined some other way (the society screen, startup) take the chapter's trait and culture.

title: A question of jurisdiction
summary: A hunter of another chapter at the same court claims the right to a case. Defer, stand firm, or put it to the lord. Fired by on_five_year_pulse (random list whchapter_rivalry).

title: A Templar denounces a lax hunter
summary: A Templar of Solkan finds a hunter of another chapter soft, drunk or worse. Fired by on_five_year_pulse (random list whchapter_rivalry).

title: The wolf-hunters of Ulric

title: The wardens of Taal
summary: Taal's wardens hunt a witch who poisoned a sacred grove.

title: The Seekers of Truth and Justice
summary: A Seeker of Verena asks to examine an accused prisoner before sentence. Fired by on_decade_pulse (whchapter_other_hunters).

title: The Ordo Fidelis
summary: The secret order that watches the witch hunters comes for the ruler's court witch hunter, whose methods have gone too far. Fired by on_decade_pulse (whchapter_other_hunters).

summary: A zealous or wrathful Templar of Solkan, not yet of his faith, is drawn to the cult itself. Only non-rulers, so the faith stays small.

title: A stage is finished
summary: Hidden. A wonder that finished a stage takes its first builder's description, unless it is a historical wonder, and gets a new name unless the player renamed it. The name may draw on its finest upgrade.

title: An upgrade is finished
summary: Hidden. Once a wonder has kept a name or a description long enough (15 to 85 years by step), a new upgrade gives it the next one. The new name or text may name this upgrade and one other. FROMFROMFROM its province.

title: A stage is looted
summary: Hidden. A looted wonder becomes "Ruins of ..." if it had reached its third stage and was never renamed, or a "Destroyed ..." otherwise, with a ruined description. The stage flags come from wonder.200 when looting starts. Fixed: the second description sat in an else with a limit (never valid), and the stage flags were cleared on the owner instead of the wonder, so a restored and looted-again wonder kept both.

title: A statue of a god is raised
summary: Hidden. Fixes the God Statue's description to one god of the owner's faith, so the name does not change from month to month.

title: A town springs up
summary: Fifty years after it was begun and with two upgrades, a wonder draws traders and pilgrims who settle around it. Let them stay (a new holding slot) or drive them off and keep what they carried. Once per province. The AI no longer needs 50 gold to welcome them (the town costs nothing). FROMFROMFROM its province.

title: The library's shelves
summary: A ruler writing a book (WHG_book_events) has a Great Library in the realm; the scribes find what they need there and the book will be finer.

title: The fountain of youth
summary: A ruler drinks from the fountain of the Magnificent Garden (decision, once in ten years) and grows two years younger. A lunatic leaps in and swallows the water the wrong way, and is two years older for it.

title: An evening at the tavern
summary: A stressed ruler with a tavern by one of the realm's wonders is asked out by a friend or a favourite of the court. Drinking the night away lifts the stress (and may start a habit, wonder.57); talking instead warms the friendship.

title: One more round
summary: The ruler keeps going back to the tavern and becomes a drunkard.

title: The traps of the old owner
summary: Two weeks after a wonder with traps changes hands, two courtiers of the new owner wander into its depths and die there (the more beloved first). The old owner, if alive, hears of it (wonder.59). Lizardmen know the traps of the old temples and are spared; a Lizardman owner gets no event. Fixed: the old check looked for a Lizardman culture on the wonder itself.

title: The traps did their work
summary: The old owner hears that the traps have taken two of the new owner's court.

title: The liege's praise
summary: A vassal who holds a wonder gets a letter of praise from the liege. Thank the liege (each comes to like the other, wonder.61) or take the credit (prestige). Fixed: the old event took the letter writer from the wonder's owner, who is the vassal himself, so the vassal praised and thanked himself.

title: The vassal's thanks
summary: My liege,The brings pilgrims, trade and glory to my lands, and I have never forgotten that I hold it under your protection. Thank you for your kind words.

title: Crumbling stone
summary: A piece falls from a destructible wonder a hundred years old. Pay for the repairs (gold, prestige) or sell the pieces (gold, but people talk).

title: A harvest from the wonder
summary: A herb garden or deep mines in the realm yield one to three herbs or precious ores (ingredient artifacts), unless the ruler already holds 15 ingredients. Fixed: both options had the same name and the herb tooltip, which also read the count after it had been spent (always 0).

title: Rumour of a lost book (start)
summary: Hidden. An independent ruler with a library upgrade picks the lost book (wonder_book_pick_effect) and the far-off realm where it is said to be, and hears of it two days later (wonder.101). Was on the yearly random_events; now the five-year list wonder_books. Fixed: the book was always sought in a realm of the real-world Muslim faiths; now any distant independent realm.

title: The lost book
summary: ROOT hears that a book by a famous author is for sale in a far-off realm. Send one of two courtiers (30 gold; wonder_book_send_emissary_effect), wait for a better time, or give up on books for good. Fixed: the second emissary's option sent the book-found and only-a-rumour events the wrong way round; an option for a missing courtier did nothing; a scholar was created at the far court every time and never used.

title: The emissary is dead
summary: The emissary died on the road; their servants bring back what is left.

title: Only a rumour
summary: The book does not exist. The emissary comes home with the rest of the purse.

title: The emissary needs more money
summary: A letter: the seller wants more. Send 50 gold (the book is found 3 in 5; an emissary who dislikes the ruler and is not honest may run off with it, wonder.105; or it was a rumour) or call the emissary home. Fixed: the run-off chance looked at the ruler's honesty instead of the emissary's.

title: The emissary runs off
summary: The emissary has fled with the money. Curse them, or (intrigue 15) pay 10 gold for men to find them (wonder.106).

title: The hunt for the thief
summary: The killers find the runaway emissary (7 in 10, twice as likely with intrigue 25), or fail and are traced back to ROOT (event 11). Fixed: while ROOT was away the event retried the runaway event (LT.20035) instead of itself.

title: The book is found
summary: The emissary brings the book home (wonder_book_make_effect; half are forgeries). Read it (learning 6: +1 learning; a forgery is found out, wonder.109), call the scholars to the Great Library (100 gold, 20 prestige; wonder.110), or put it on a shelf (20 prestige; a forgery is found out by a visiting scholar in one to two years, wonder.108).

title: A scholar finds the forgery
summary: A visiting scholar shows that the book is a forgery (it becomes the Clever Forgery). Jail the scholar, or reward them and keep them at court. Either way the court knows (Forgery Discovered).

title: I find the forgery
summary: Reading the book, ROOT finds it is a forgery (it becomes the Clever Forgery). Learn from it anyway (+1 learning; Forgery Discovered) or burn it.

title: The gathering of scholars
summary: Three scholars from nearby courts come to the Great Library to judge the book, and stay at ROOT's court. A real book: 75 prestige, 75 culture points and Patron of the Arts for two years, and a chronicle entry. A forgery: the scholars find it out, but the debate was worth 10 prestige and 25 culture points. Fixed: a forgery gave more (50 points in every field) than a real book; the scholars could be any courtier of the nearby courts, spouses and heirs too (now unwed scholars without office, wonder_book_scholar_trigger).

title: Digging begins (start)
summary: Hidden. When a wonder or upgrade starts building, the diggers may break into an old tomb within 50 to 1950 days (wonder.121).

title: A tomb under the works
summary: The diggers at a wonder still being built break into an old tomb. Pay to open it (an accident, nothing, gold, or 1 in 10 a treasure), have it opened by someone who knows the work (learning 15, erudite or architect: no accident, better finds), leave it be, or never be bothered again.

title: What the tomb held
summary: An accident (a collapse kills workers: pay the families, or not), nothing, grave goods (keep them, greed, or share them with the workers, charity), or a treasure: an old knight's armour or sword, an emerald sceptre, a saint's finger bone in the lands of the Old World faiths, or a Nehekharan tomb blade in the lands of the Tomb Kings' faith. Each only if ROOT does not have one already. Fixed: the finger bone was an artifact the mod does not have (fingerbone_of_saint; now saintly_finger), the workers' anger flag was set and cleared at once.

title: The armoury's master smith
summary: A ruler who hired a smith (wh_armoury_events, ARMS.10) has an Armoury upgrade and lets its own master do the work instead. Choose the weapon: a sword (not in Araby or Cathay), a zweihander (the Empire, Tilea and Estalia), a scimitar (Araby and Cathay), a lance, an axe, a mace (not for nomads), a bow (nomads), or armour from an armoursmith. The smith delivers in 40 to 60 days (wonder.131).

title: The smith is done
summary: Hidden. The smith takes the work to the employer (their liege if the employer has died), wonder.132.

title: Fine work from the armoury
summary: The master smith hands over the weapon or armour. Fixed: the old event looked for the smith's flags with a chain of if blocks and cleared them on the employer, so they stayed on the smith and a second order could make two weapons.

title: A visit to the dungeons
summary: A ruler with a frightening upgrade (torture chambers, a bone hall) shows it to a guest (decision use_scary_upgrade). Frighten them (they are cowed, or they take it as a threat; a cruel guest laughs, wonder.141), press them for a favour (Conclave), impress a cruel guest, or turn it into a joke for a kind one. Diplomacy helps; a guest of a higher tier, or a brave one, is harder to frighten.

title: They laughed at me
summary: A cruel guest was not frightened, only amused.

title: An invitation
summary: The guest is invited to the secluded place: accept (wonder.151), refuse (wonder.152, the host is offended), or with diplomacy 15 refuse politely.

title: The meeting
summary: Talk (wonder.153), try to seduce the guest (wonder.155; likely only with a guest who may love the host), meet a lover there (stress may go, romance may bud; wonder.157), or try to kill the guest (intrigue 15 or a scheming nature; wonder.159).

title: The guest refused
summary: The host is offended, unless the guest refused politely.

title: A good talk
summary: The guest is thoroughly impressed, impressed (the host hears it, wonder.154) or unmoved; the host's diplomacy decides.

title: How the talk went
summary: Notification for the host.

title: The host's advances
summary: Become lovers (wonder.156), take what is offered without love, refuse (wonder.158), or (intrigue 10 or a scheming nature) try to kill the host instead (wonder.159).

title: Lovers

title: A knife in the garden
summary: Run (1 in 4 unhurt, more if quick, a duelist, shrewd or a genius; 1 in 2 wounded; 1 in 4 killed) or fight (an even chance, moved by the combat ratings). Either way the attacker is hated. Fixed: the victim's death named no killer; now the attacker.

title: I got away
summary: I ran, and I did not stop running until I was among my guards. I am alive, and unhurt, and I will never set foot in that place again.

title: I am dying

title: A ruler with a burial ground dies
summary: Hidden. Marks who in the realm liked (opinion 20) or hated (below -50) the dead ruler, and asks the heir how to bury them (wonder.171).

title: Where to lay them
summary: The heir decides how to bury their predecessor in the realm's burial wonder: a great funeral (wonder.172 in ten days), a fitting one (wonder.172 in five), the cheapest (piety, a loss of prestige), or no proper burial at all (those who liked the dead are angry, those who hated them pleased). The text follows the heir's faith. Fixed: the descs used the texts for Christians, Muslims, Jews and Hindus; the realm's marks were never cleared (a has_flag typo, and the flags sat on the realm's characters, not the heir).

title: The funeral
summary: The dead are laid in the wonder. A great funeral: 150 prestige and 50 piety; those who liked the dead are grateful, those who hated them offended. A fitting one: 50 prestige and 100 piety; those who liked the dead are grateful for a year. Fixed: the fitting funeral sat in an else_if with no limit.

title: A relic for the shrine
summary: A ruler building a relic-keeping upgrade (decision store_relic_in_wonder) lays one of up to three holy artifacts in it, for piety and prestige by its quality (100 piety for the least, 500 of each for the finest), or keeps them. If the artifact is no longer the ruler's when it is laid down, the gods strike the cheat (wonder.181). Fixed: the decision's artifact marks (target_artifact_1 - 4) were never cleared.

title: The gods are not mocked
summary: The relic promised to the gods was not the ruler's to give. Lightning.

title: Walls for the townships
summary: When an upgrade is finished at a wonder with the Strategic Exclaves, every holding in its county gets the strongest walls of its kind, as the upgrade promises. Once per wonder. Revived: the vanilla event was a province event on a character on_action and was switched off, so the upgrade never built its walls.

title: Looting begins: remember the stage
summary: Hidden. Marks the wonder as ruined and remembers how far it was built, for the ruin's name (wonder.3).

title: Looting begins: a treasure
summary: Hidden. A looted wonder that holds a treasure (bells, books) yields it to the looter's men in about three weeks (wonder.202).

title: The looters' prize
summary: One of the looter's courtiers brings out the wonder's bells or a book. Take it, or let them keep it (they are grateful). Fixed: every courtier of the looter got a copy of the treasure, and the "take it" option sent it to the wonder instead of the looter.

title: A wonder is restored
summary: Hidden. A restored wonder can be looted for treasure again.

title: How to loot it
summary: The looter chooses: only their own men loot (the province suffers cultural unrest for two years) or anyone may join (less gold, wonder.205).

title: A stage is stripped
summary: Notification: the looters bring in 300, 500 or 800 gold by the cost of the wonder (400 if unknown), half if everyone joined in.

title: The soldiers run wild
summary: After a siege the troops of a commander who may not loot start to sack a rich holding (four buildings or more). Let them (a building burns, maybe the wonder is damaged; the holder and their liege are furious, the realm thinks ROOT dishonourable), join in (10 gold, 30 more from a wonder; wroth and cruel may follow; a worse name), or try to stop them (by martial: lose a twentieth of the troops and gain a name for discipline, or fail and get a name for weak command). Not for nomads, who have their own (nomad.24).
